November 1st, 2025
==================
**Breaking Changes:**
- :warning: ([smithy-rs#4367](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4367)) Upgrade MSRV to Rust 1.88.0.

**New this release:**
- :tada: ([aws-sdk-rust#1366](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1366), @c-thiel) Add tags to `AssumeRoleProviderBuilder`
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#4352](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4352), [smithy-rs#4353](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4353)) Update clients to allow `initial-response` events to be accepted on event streams, even when know modeled initial response exists.

    This is required for spec compliance, backwards compatibility, and compatibility with non-smithy-rs based servers that
    MAY unconditionally send `initial-response` messages.
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#4265](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4265), [smithy-rs#4189](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4189)) Adds new `with_test_defaults_v2()` for all clients supporting region configuration which applies `us-east-1` as default region if not set by user. This allows `aws-smithy-mocks` to work for non AWS SDK generated clients. Also clarify `test-util` feature requirement when using `aws-smithy-mocks`.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.106.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-connectcases` (1.96.0): Added two new case rule types: Parent Child Field Options (restricts child field options based on parent field value) and Hidden (controls child field visibility based on parent field value). Both enable dynamic field behavior within templates.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.178.0): Amazon VPC IP Address Manager (IPAM) now supports automated prefix list management, allowing you to create rules that automatically populate customer-managed prefix lists with CIDRs from your IPAM pools or AWS resources based on tags, Regions, or other criteria.
- `aws-sdk-emr` (1.95.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-fms` (1.92.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.98.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-health` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-kinesis` (1.93.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.103.0): Add Python3.14 (python3.14) and Java 25 (java25) support to AWS Lambda
- `aws-sdk-marketplacecatalog` (1.93.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.109.0): Adds SlowPalPitchCorrection to audio pitch correction settings. Enables opacity for VideoOverlays. Adds REMUX_ALL option to enable multi-rendition passthrough to VideoSelector for allow listed accounts.
- `aws-sdk-omics` (1.95.0): Added WDL_LENIENT engine type that enables implicit typecasting of variable values to its compatible declared types
- `aws-sdk-paymentcryptography` (1.95.0): Allow additional characters in the CertificateSubject for GetCertificateSigningRequest API.
- `aws-sdk-redshift` (1.93.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-resourcegroupstagging` (1.87.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.164.0): Allow update of platform identifier via UpdateNotebookInstance operation.
- `aws-sdk-savingsplans` (1.89.0): Add dual-stack endpoint support for Savings Plans
- `aws-sdk-snowball` (1.87.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-ssmquicksetup` (1.52.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-textract` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-waf` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing

**Contributors**
Thank you for your contributions! ❤
- @c-thiel ([aws-sdk-rust#1366](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1366))

==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amp` (1.93.0): Add Anomaly Detection APIs for Amazon Managed Prometheus
- `aws-sdk-apigateway` (1.90.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-appconfig` (1.92.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing

- `aws-sdk-auditmanager` (1.91.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.117.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.18.0): Web-Bot-Auth support for AgentCore Browser tool to help reduce captcha challenges.
- `aws-sdk-chime` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.105.0): Added support for advanced Spark configurations to optimize SQL performance
- `aws-sdk-cloudcontrol` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing

- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.81.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-devopsguru` (1.87.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-docdb` (1.94.0): Adding FailoverState and TagList to GlobalCluster and SynchronizationStatus to GlobalClusterMember.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.102.0): Amazon ECS Service Connect now supports Envoy access logs, providing deeper observability into request-level traffic patterns and service interactions.
- `aws-sdk-eksauth` (1.84.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-elasticache` (1.93.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-emrserverless` (1.95.0): This release adds the capability to enable User Background Sessions for customers running Trusted Identity Propagation enabled Interactive Sessions on EMR Serverless Applications.
- `aws-sdk-firehose` (1.95.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-frauddetector` (1.87.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-geoplaces` (1.41.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.126.0): This release adds the capability to enable User Background Sessions for customers running Trusted Identity Propagation enabled Interactive Sessions on AWS Glue.
- `aws-sdk-greengrassv2` (1.88.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-ioteventsdata` (1.87.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-iotmanagedintegrations` (1.29.0): Add a new GetManagedThingCertificate API to expose Iot ManagedIntegrations (MI) device certificate, and add  "-"  support for name, properties, actions and events in the CapabilityReportCapability object.
- `aws-sdk-keyspacesstreams` (1.14.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-kms` (1.91.0): Add cross account VPC endpoint service connectivity support to CustomKeyStore.

October 28th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-apigatewayv2` (1.89.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-applicationsignals` (1.65.0): Added support for CloudWatch Synthetics Canary resources in ListAuditFindings API. This enhancement allows customers to retrieve audit findings specifically for CloudWatch Synthetics canaries and enables service-canary correlation analysis.
- `aws-sdk-backupsearch` (1.36.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
- `aws-sdk-bcmpricingcalculator` (1.42.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing

- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.101.0): Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing

October 21st, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.96.0): Add AccountID based endpoint metric to endpoint rules.
- `aws-sdk-emr` (1.94.0): Added RECONFIGURING to the InstanceFleetState convenience enum.
- `aws-sdk-marketplacemetering` (1.89.0): Added ClientToken parameter to MeterUsage API for specifying idempotent requests.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.108.0): This release adds the ability to set resolution for the black video generator and also adds the StartJobsQuery and GetJobsQueryResults APIs which allow asynchronous search of job history using new filters.

October 15th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.118.0): Amazon Bedrock Automated Reasoning Policy now offers enhanced AWS KMS integration. The CreateAutomatedReasoningPolicy API includes a new kmsKeyId field, allowing customers to specify their preferred KMS key for encryption, improving control and compliance with AWS encryption mandates.
- `aws-sdk-docdb` (1.92.0): Add support for NetworkType field in CreateDbCluster, ModifyDbCluster, RestoreDbClusterFromSnapshot and RestoreDbClusterToPointInTime for DocumentDB.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.175.0): Introducing EC2 Capacity Manager for monitoring and analyzing capacity usage across On-Demand Instances, Spot Instances, and Capacity Reservations.
- `aws-sdk-elasticloadbalancingv2` (1.97.0): This release expands Listener Rule Conditions to support RegexValues and adds support for a new Transforms field in Listener Rules.
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.101.0): Added default pagination value for ListMalwareProtectionPlans API and updated UpdateFindingsFeedback API
- `aws-sdk-lightsail` (1.93.0): Add support for manage Lightsail Bucket CORS configuration
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.76.0): This release adds support for creating and managing InfluxDB 3 Core and Enterprise DbClusters.

October 14th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.93.0): This release introduces support for Microsoft license included applications streaming.
- `aws-sdk-backup` (1.94.0): The AWS Backup job attribute extension enhancement helps customers better understand the plan that initiated each job, and the properties of the resource each job creates.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.133.0): SDK release for TaskTemplateInfo in Contact for DescribeContact response.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.108.0): Support creating scoped and trustedIdentityPropagation enabled connections.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.174.0): This release adds support for creating instant, point-in-time copies of EBS volumes within the same Availability Zone
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.92.0): Move UntagResource API body member to query parameter
- `aws-sdk-transfer` (1.100.0): SFTP connectors now support routing connections via customers' VPC. This enables connections to remote servers that are only accessible in a customer's VPC environment, and to servers that are accessible over the internet but need connections coming from an IP address in a customer VPC's CIDR range.

October 13th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcore` (1.14.0): Updated InvokeAgentRuntime API to accept account id optionally and added CompleteResourceTokenAuth API.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.16.0): Updated http status code in control plane apis of agentcore runtime, tools and identity. Additional included provider types for AgentCore Identity
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.173.0): Release Amazon EC2 c8i, c8i-flex, m8a, and r8gb
- `aws-sdk-observabilityadmin` (1.40.0): CloudWatch Observability Admin adds the ability to enable Resource tags for telemetry in a customer account. The release introduces new APIs to enable, disable and describe the status of Resource tags for telemetry feature. This new capability simplifies monitoring AWS resources using tags.

October 10th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcore` (1.13.0): Bedrock AgentCore release for Runtime, and Memory.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.15.0): Bedrock AgentCore release for Gateway, and Memory including Self-Managed Strategies support for Memory.
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.98.0): Added new viewer security policy, TLSv1.2_2025, for CloudFront.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.125.0): Addition of AuditContext in GetTable/GetTables Request
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.100.0): Add InvokedViaFunctionUrl context key to limit invocations to only FURL invokes.
- `aws-sdk-odb` (1.13.0): This release adds APIs that allow you to specify CIDR ranges in your ODB peering connection.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.112.1): Updated the text in the Important section of the ModifyDBClusterParameterGroup page.

October 9th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.109.0): This release adds support for ActionConnector and Flow, which are new resources associated with Amazon Quick Suite. Additional updates include expanded Data Source options, further branding customization, and new capabilities that can be restricted by Admins.
- `aws-sdk-wafv2` (1.99.0): This release adds the ability to throw WafLimitsExceededException when the maximum number of Application Load Balancer (ALB) associations per AWS WAF v2 WebACL is exceeded.

October 8th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.14.0): Adding support for authorizer type AWS_IAM to AgentCore Control Gateway.
- `aws-sdk-licensemanagerusersubscriptions` (1.89.0): Released support for IPv6 and dual-stack active directories
- `aws-sdk-outposts` (1.96.0): This release adds the new StartOutpostDecommission API, which starts the decommission process to return Outposts racks or servers.
- `aws-sdk-servicequotas` (1.88.0): introduces Service Quotas Automatic Management. Users can opt-in to monitoring and managing service quotas, receive notifications when quota usage reaches thresholds, configure notification channels, subscribe to EventBridge events for automation, and view notifications in the AWS Health dashboard.

October 6th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-backup` (1.92.0): Adds optional MaxScheduledRunsPreview input to GetBackupPlan API to provide a preview of up to 10 next scheduled backup plan runs in the GetBackupPlan response.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcore` (1.11.0): Add support for batch memory management, agent card retrieval and session termination
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.12.0): Add support for VM lifecycle configuration parameters and A2A protocol
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.123.0): Adds labeling for DataQualityRuleResult for GetDataQualityResult and PublishDataQualityResult APIs
- `aws-sdk-mediaconnect` (1.91.0): Enabling Tag-on-Create for AWS Elemental MediaConnect flow-based resource types
- `aws-sdk-memorydb` (1.89.0): Support for DescribeMultiRegionParameterGroups and DescribeMultiRegionParameters API.
- `aws-sdk-resourceexplorer2` (1.89.0): Add new AWS Resource Explorer APIs

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.107.1): Documentation improvements for QuickSight API documentation to clarify that delete operation APIs are global.
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.111.1): Documentation updates to the CreateDBClusterMessage$PubliclyAccessible and CreateDBInstanceMessage$PubliclyAccessible properties.

October 3rd, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.103.0): Added support for reading data sources across regions, and results delivery to allowedlisted regions.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.110.0): AWS Elemental MediaLive enables Mediapackage V2 users to configure ID3, KLV, Nielsen ID3, and Segment Length related parameters through the Mediapackage output group.
- `aws-sdk-paymentcryptographydata` (1.91.0): Added a new API - translateKeyMaterial; allows keys wrapped by ECDH derived keys to be rewrapped under a static AES keyblock without first importing the key into the service.
- `aws-sdk-qconnect` (1.95.0): Updated Amazon Q in Connect APIs to support Email Contact Recommendations.

October 3rd, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudformation` (1.95.0): Add new warning type 'EXCLUDED_RESOURCES'
- `aws-sdk-connectcases` (1.93.0): New Search All Related Items API enables searching related items across cases
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.94.0): Add support for dual-stack account endpoint generation
- `aws-sdk-synthetics` (1.93.0): Adds support to configure canaries with pre-configured blueprint code on supported runtime versions.  This behavior can be controlled via the new BlueprintTypes property exposed in the CreateCanary and UpdateCanary APIs.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.99.0): Updated descriptions for the Location parameter in CreateTrustedEntitySet and CreateThreatEntitySet.

October 1st, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-chimesdkmeetings` (1.86.0): Add support to receive dual stack MediaPlacement URLs in Chime Meetings SDK
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.101.0): This release introduces data access budgets to control how many times a table can be used for queries and jobs in a collaboration.
- `aws-sdk-cleanroomsml` (1.88.0): This release introduces data access budgets to view how many times an input channel can be used for ML jobs in a collaboration.
- `aws-sdk-ivsrealtime` (1.95.0): Remove incorrect ReadOnly trait on IVS RealTime ImportPublicKey API
- `aws-sdk-pcs` (1.53.0): Added the UpdateCluster API action to modify cluster configurations, and Slurm custom settings for queues.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.93.1): This is a doc-only update, revising text for kms-key-arns.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.98.1): This is a documentation only Amazon ECS release that adds additional information for health checks.

September 30th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-applicationsignals` (1.61.0): Amazon CloudWatch Application Signals is introducing the Application Map to give users a more comprehensive view of their service health. Users will now be able to group services, track their latest deployments, and view automated audit findings concerning service performance.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.10.0): Tagging support for AgentCore Gateway
- `aws-sdk-chimesdkvoice` (1.88.0): Added support for IPv4-only and dual-stack network configurations for VoiceConnector and CreateVoiceConnector API.
- `aws-sdk-connectcases` (1.92.0): This release adds support for two new related item types: ConnectCase for linking Amazon Connect cases and Custom for user-defined related items with configurable fields.
- `aws-sdk-customerprofiles` (1.93.0): This release introduces ListProfileHistoryRecords and GetProfileHistoryRecord APIs for comprehensive profile history tracking with complete audit trails of creation, updates, merges, deletions, and data ingestion events.
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.92.0): Added support for FIPS VPC endpoints in FIPS-enabled AWS Regions.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.105.0): This release adds support for creation of EMR on EKS Connections in Amazon DataZone.
- `aws-sdk-directory` (1.89.0): AWS Directory service now supports IPv6-native and dual-stack configurations for AWS Managed Microsoft AD, AD Connector, and Simple AD (dual-stack only). Additionally, AWS Managed Microsoft AD Standard Edition directories can be upgraded to Enterprise Edition directories through a single API call.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.98.0): This release adds support for Managed Instances on Amazon ECS.
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.95.0): Add Dual-Stack support for Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP and Windows File Server
- `aws-sdk-mediatailor` (1.92.0): Adding TPS Traffic Shaping to Prefetch Schedules
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.110.0): Enhanced RDS error handling: Added DBProxyEndpointNotFoundFault, DBShardGroupNotFoundFault, KMSKeyNotAccessibleFault for snapshots/restores/backups, NetworkTypeNotSupported, StorageTypeNotSupportedFault for restores, and granular state validation faults. Changed DBInstanceNotReadyFault to HTTP 400.
- `aws-sdk-transfer` (1.97.0): Add support for updating server identity provider type

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.106.1): added warnings to a few CLI pages

September 29th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.115.0): Release for fixing GetFoundationModel API behavior. Imported and custom models have their own exclusive API and GetFM should not accept those ARNS as input
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.107.0): New stop reason for Converse and ConverseStream
- `aws-sdk-imagebuilder` (1.91.0): This release introduces several new features and improvements to enhance pipeline management, logging, and resource configuration.
- `aws-sdk-vpclattice` (1.87.0): Adds support for specifying the number of IPv4 addresses in each ENI for the resource gateway for VPC Lattice.

September 26th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.111.0): This release enhances the information provided through Flow Traces. New information includes source/next node tracking, execution chains for complex nodes, dependency action (operation) details, and dependency traces.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomation` (1.37.0): Added support for configurable Speaker Labeling and Channel Labeling features for Audio modality.
- `aws-sdk-billing` (1.38.0): Add ability to combine custom billing views to create new consolidated views.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.130.0): Adds supports for manual contact picking (WorkList) operations on Routing Profiles, Agent Management and SearchContacts APIs.
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.95.0): Support for payer account dimension and billing view health status.
- `aws-sdk-dynamodbstreams` (1.85.0): Added support for IPv6 compatible endpoints for DynamoDB Streams.
- `aws-sdk-redshift` (1.90.0): Support tagging and tag propagation to IAM Identity Center for Redshift Idc Applications

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.170.1): This release includes documentation updates for Amazon EBS General Purpose SSD (gp3) volumes with larger size and higher IOPS and throughput.

September 25th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.121.0): Update GetConnection(s) API to return KmsKeyArn & Add 63 missing connection types
- `aws-sdk-lightsail` (1.90.0): Attribute HTTP binding update for Get/Delete operations
- `aws-sdk-networkfirewall` (1.93.0): Network Firewall now introduces Reject and Alert action support for stateful domain list rule groups, providing customers with more granular control over their network traffic.

September 24th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatch` (1.92.0): Fix default dualstack FIPS endpoints in AWS GovCloud(US) regions
- `aws-sdk-dax` (1.85.0): This release adds support for IPv6-only, DUAL_STACK DAX instances

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.90.1): G6f instance support for AppStream 2.0
- `aws-sdk-kms` (1.87.1): Documentation only updates for KMS.
- `aws-sdk-neptune` (1.87.1): Doc-only update to address customer use.

September 23rd, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.100.0): Added support for running incremental ID mapping for rule-based workflows.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.170.0): Add Amazon EC2 R8gn instance types
- `aws-sdk-entityresolution` (1.93.0): Support incremental id mapping workflow for AWS Entity Resolution
- `aws-sdk-ssm` (1.94.0): Added Dualstack support to GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
- `aws-sdk-ssoadmin` (1.86.0): Add support for encryption at rest with Customer Managed KMS Key in AWS IAM Identity Center
- `aws-sdk-ssooidc` (1.86.0): This release includes exception definition and documentation updates.

September 22nd, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.108.0): Adds support for RepairConfig overrides and configurations in EKS Managed Node Groups.
- `aws-sdk-imagebuilder` (1.90.0): Version ARNs are no longer required for the EC2 Image Builder list-image-build-version, list-component-build-version, and list-workflow-build-version APIs. Calling these APIs without the ARN returns all build versions for the given resource type in the requesting account.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.95.1): Starting in JAN 2026, AWS Batch will change the default AMI for new Amazon ECS compute environments from Amazon Linux 2 to Amazon Linux 2023. We recommend migrating AWS Batch Amazon ECS compute environments to Amazon Linux 2023 to maintain optimal performance and security.

September 19th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.9.0): Add tagging and VPC support to AgentCore Runtime, Code Interpreter, and Browser resources. Add support for configuring request headers in Runtime. Fix AgentCore Runtime shape names.
- `aws-sdk-config` (1.89.0): Add UNKNOWN state to RemediationExecutionState and add IN_PROGRESS/EXITED/UNKNOWN states to RemediationExecutionStepState.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.129.0): This release adds a persistent connection field to UserPhoneConfig that maintains agent's softphone media connection for faster call connections.
- `aws-sdk-licensemanagerusersubscriptions` (1.86.0): Added support for cross-account Active Directories.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.108.0): Add MinBitrate for QVBR mode under H264/H265/AV1 output codec. Add GopBReference, GopNumBFrames, SubGopLength fields under H265 output codec.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-kendraranking` (1.83.1): Model whitespace change - no client difference
- `aws-sdk-sqs` (1.84.1): Update invalid character handling documentation for SQS SendMessage API

September 18th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.114.0): Release includes an increase to the maximum policy build document size, an update to DeleteAutomatedReasoningPolicyBuildWorkflow to add ResourceInUseException, and corrections to UpdateAutomatedReasoningPolicyTestCaseRequest.
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.90.0): Added BillingViewHealthStatus Exception which is thrown when a Budget is created or updated with a Billing View that is not in the HEALTHY status
- `aws-sdk-chimesdkmessaging` (1.85.0): Amazon Chime SDK Messaging GetMessagingSessionEndpoint API now returns dual-stack WebSocket endpoints supporting IPv4/IPv6.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.169.0): Allowed AMIs adds support for four new parameters - marketplaceProductCodes, deprecationTimeCondition, creationDateCondition and imageNames

September 17th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.168.0): Add mac-m4.metal and mac-m4pro.metal instance types.
- `aws-sdk-networkfirewall` (1.92.0): Network Firewall now prevents TLS handshakes with the target server until after the Server Name Indication (SNI) has been seen and verified. The monitoring dashboard now provides deeper insights into PrivateLink endpoint candidates and offers filters based on IP addresses and protocol.
- `aws-sdk-pcs` (1.52.0): Add support for Amazon EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML

September 16th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.89.0): Add support for custom time periods in budget configuration
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.103.0): Cloudwatch Logs added support for 2 new API parameters in metric and subscription filter APIs to filter log events based on system field values and emit system field values as dimensions and send them to customer destination as additional metadata.
- `aws-sdk-ivsrealtime` (1.94.0): IVS now offers customers the ability to control the positioning of participants in both grid and PiP layouts based on custom attribute values in participant tokens.
- `aws-sdk-osis` (1.88.0): Adds support for cross-account ingestion for push-based sources. This includes resource policies for sharing pipelines across accounts and features for managing pipeline endpoints which enable accessing pipelines across different VPCs, including VPCs in other accounts.

September 15th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.94.0): Added endpoint support for eusc-de-east-1 region.
- `aws-sdk-medicalimaging` (1.89.0): Added support for OpenID Connect (OIDC) custom authorizer
- `aws-sdk-observabilityadmin` (1.37.0): CloudWatch Observability Admin adds the ability to enable telemetry centralization in customers' Organizations. The release introduces new APIs to manage centralization rules, which define settings to replicate telemetry data to a central destination in the customers' Organization.
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.98.0): Introduce three new encryption filters: EncryptionType (SSE-S3, SSE-KMS, DSSE-KMS, SSE-C, NOT-SSE), KmsKeyArn (for SSE-KMS and DSSE-KMS), and BucketKeyEnabled (for SSE-KMS).

====================

September 11th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amp` (1.88.0): Add Vended Logs APIs for Amazon Prometheus Managed Collector
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.103.0): adding IAM principal id to IAM user profile details
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.96.0): This release supports hook details for Amazon ECS lifecycle hooks.
- `aws-sdk-emrcontainers` (1.89.0): Added nodeLabel support in container provider to aid hardware isolation support for virtual cluster and security configuration.
- `aws-sdk-evs` (1.13.0): CreateEnvironment API now supports parameters (isHcxPublic & hcxNetworkAclId) for HCX migration via public internet, adding flexibility for migration scenarios. New APIs have been added for associating (AssociateEipToVlan) & disassociating (DisassociateEipFromVlan) Elastic IP (EIP) addresses.
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.97.0): Updated Java SDK implementation of entity set status in GuardDuty API.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.106.0): AWS Elemental MediaLive adds a new feature in MediaPackage output group that enables MediaPackage V2 users to control HLS-related parameters directly in MediaLive. These parameter settings are then reflected in MediaPackage outputs, providing more streamlined control over HLS configurations.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.105.0): This release adds support for Account level custom permissions, additional Dashboard Options, and Null support for Q&A.
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.108.0): Adds support for end-to-end IAM authentication in RDS Proxy for MySQL, MariaDB, and PostgreSQL engines.

September 10th, 2025
====================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-networkflowmonitor` (1.37.0): Added new enum value (AWS::Region) for type field under MonitorLocalResource and MonitorRemoteResource. Workload Insights and Monitor top contributors queries now support a new DestinationCategory (INTER_REGION).
- `aws-sdk-paymentcryptography` (1.90.0): AWS Payment Cryptography Service now supports Multi-Region key replication. Customers can choose to automatically distribute keys across AWS Regions.

September 9th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-autoscaling` (1.94.0): Added WaitForTransitioningInstances parameter to the CancelInstanceRefresh API, allowing the caller to cancel an instance refresh without waiting for on-going launches and terminations.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatch` (1.90.0): Added a new API - DescribeAlarmContributors API, to retrieve alarm contributors in ALARM state. Added support in DescribeAlarmHistory API to query alarm contributor history
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.127.0): SDK release for user defined predefined attributes.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.102.0): Adds support for custom blueprints
- `aws-sdk-mediapackagev2` (1.93.0): Added CUE tag SCTE output to MediaPackageV2 HLS and LL-HLS manifests.
- `aws-sdk-organizations` (1.93.0): Documentation updates for AWS Organizations APIs.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.157.0): Released IPv6 support with dual-stack domain options on SageMaker Studio and introduced support for p6-b200.48xlarge instance type on SageMaker Studio for JupyterLab and CodeEditor applications.

September 8th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-iotsitewise` (1.90.0): Add ComputationModelVersion support in IoT SiteWise APIs
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.105.0): This release includes backward compatibility work on the "Expires" parameter.
- `aws-sdk-securityhub` (1.91.0): This release adds the RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND error code as a possible value in responses to the following operations: BatchGetStandardsControlAssociations, BatchUpdateStandardsControlAssociations, and BatchGetSecurityControls.

September 5th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.156.0): Release IPv6 support with dualstack in SageMaker Notebooks, Tiered Storage Checkpointing Support in SageMaker HyperPod and P5.4xlarge instance type for SageMaker Hosting.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.95.1): This is a documentation only release that adds additional information for Amazon ECS Availability Zone rebalancing.
- `aws-sdk-pcs` (1.50.1): Documentation-only update to add AccountingStorageEnforce to SlurmCustomSetting.

September 4th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.98.0): Add support for configurable compute sizes for PySpark jobs.
- `aws-sdk-cloudformation` (1.93.0): ListHookResults API now supports retrieving invocation results for all CloudFormation Hooks (previously limited to create change set and Cloud Control operations) with new optional parameters for filtering by Hook status and ARN.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.166.0): Add m8i, m8i-flex and i8ge instance types.
- `aws-sdk-opensearchserverless` (1.90.0): Add support for Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) and Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) compliance
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.107.0): Added new EndpointNetworkType and TargetConnectionNetworkType fields in Proxy APIs to support IPv6
- `aws-sdk-verifiedpermissions` (1.93.0): Amazon Verified Permissions / Features : Adds support for datetime and duration attribute values.

September 3rd, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.97.0): Added support for adding new data provider members to an existing collaboration.
- `aws-sdk-cleanroomsml` (1.86.0): AWS Clean Rooms ML adds log sanitization for privacy-enhanced error summaries, supports new instance types for custom models providing better performance and lower costs, and deprecates P3-series instances.
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.94.0): Adding an optional field IpAddressType in CustomOriginConfig
- `aws-sdk-mq` (1.86.0): Add CONFIG_MANAGED as a supported AuthenticationStrategy for Amazon MQ for RabbitMQ brokers. Make username and password optional on broker creation for CONFIG_MANAGED brokers.
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.106.0): This release adds support for MasterUserAuthenticationType parameter on CreateDBInstance, ModifyDBInstance, CreateDBCluster, and ModifyDBCluster operations.
- `aws-sdk-route53` (1.94.0): Amazon Route 53 now supports the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region (ap-southeast-6) for latency records, geoproximity records, and private DNS for Amazon VPCs in that region.
- `aws-sdk-route53domains` (1.87.0): Added new ExtraParams AU_ELIGIBILITY_TYPE, AU_POLICY_REASON, and AU_REGISTRANT_NAME
- `aws-sdk-transcribestreaming` (1.86.0): This release adds support for automatic language identification in AWS Transcribe Call Analytics

September 2nd, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.165.0): MaximumEbsAttachments and AttachmentLimitType fields added to DescribeInstanceTypesResponse. G6f, Gr6f, R8i, R8i-flex and p5.4xlarge instance types added to InstanceTypes enum.
- `aws-sdk-neptune` (1.86.0): Removed the deprecated marker from publiclyAccessible parameter from DbInstance, CreateDbInstance and ModifyDbInstance and added relevant usage information for the parameter.
- `aws-sdk-notifications` (1.36.0): Added Org support for notifications:  - `ListMemberAccounts` gets member accounts list, `AssociateOrganizationalUnit` links OU to notification configuration, `DisassociateOrganizationalUnit` removes OU from notification configuration, `ListOrganizationalUnits` shows OUs configured for notifications.
- `aws-sdk-workmail` (1.85.0): Make RoleArn an optional parameter for the PutEmailMonitoringConfiguration API, and add UnsupportedOperationException to RegisterToWorkMail.

August 29th, 2025
=================
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([aws-sdk-rust#169](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/169)) Add support for proxy environment variables (`HTTP_PROXY, `HTTPS_PROXY`, `ALL_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY`). Service clients will now automatically respect these proxy environment variables on the latest `BehaviorVersion`. Older behavior versions do not automatically detect these environment variables and will require manually building a `aws_smithy_http_client::Connector` with a proxy config explicitly set to use this feature.
- :tada: (@WillChilds-Klein) Enable rustls post-quantum by default.
- fix `aws-smithy-eventstream` feature `derive-arbitrary` on `arbitrary` >= 1.4.2
- ([smithy-rs#4263](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4263)) Make [`TokenBucket`](https://docs.rs/aws-smithy-runtime/latest/aws_smithy_runtime/client/retries/struct.TokenBucket.html) and [`ClientRateLimiter`](https://docs.rs/aws-smithy-runtime/latest/aws_smithy_runtime/client/retries/struct.ClientRateLimiter.html) configurable through [`RetryPartition`](https://docs.rs/aws-smithy-runtime/latest/aws_smithy_runtime/client/retries/struct.RetryPartition.html).

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.105.0): Fixed stop sequence limit for converse API.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.164.0): Release shows new route types such as filtered and advertisement.
- `aws-sdk-xray` (1.84.0): AWS X-Ray Features: Support Sampling Rate Boost On Anomaly

**Contributors**
Thank you for your contributions! ❤
- @WillChilds-Klein

August 20th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.103.0): Launch CountTokens API to allow token counting
- `aws-sdk-billing` (1.35.0): Clarify IPv4 and IPv6 endpoints
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.86.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.96.0): This release adds support for the new Terms APIs which allow displaying Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on the Managed Login user-registration page.
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.91.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.99.0): This release supports policy grant identifier for cloud formation integration
- `aws-sdk-detective` (1.83.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.90.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-efs` (1.85.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.103.0): EKS Add-ons Custom Namespace Support
- `aws-sdk-iam` (1.87.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-kinesis` (1.86.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-kinesisanalyticsv2` (1.86.0): Adds Key Management Service (KMS) support allowing customer-managed key (CMK) encryption for Flink application data.
- `aws-sdk-marketplaceentitlement` (1.86.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-marketplacemetering` (1.84.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-networkmanager` (1.86.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-pinpointsmsvoicev2` (1.88.0): This change added InternationalSendingEnbaled as part of describe/Update/Request phone number API response, and as part of update/Request phone number API request
- `aws-sdk-route53recoverycontrolconfig` (1.83.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.152.0): This release adds 1/ Launch ml.p5.4xlarge instance in Processing jobs, Training jobs and Training Plan 2/ Makes S3Uri to be required for S3FileSystem and S3FileSystemConfig.
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.95.0): Remove incorrect endpoint tests

August 19th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.94.0): Support error message configuration for analysis templates
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.160.0): Add support for "warning" volume status.
- `aws-sdk-polly` (1.86.0): Added support for new output format - Opus.

August 18th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bcmdashboards` (1.0.0): Billing and Cost Management Dashboards enables users to create dashboards that combine multiple visualizations of cost and usage data. Users can create, manage, and share dashboards. Tags are also available for dashboards.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.123.0): Amazon Connect Service Feature: Add support to enable multi-user in-app, web, and video calling.
- `aws-sdk-connectparticipant` (1.84.0): Amazon Connect Service Feature: Add support to enable multi-user in-app, web, and video calling.
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.95.0): Adds support for Compute checksum functionality in Amazon S3 Batch Operations. You can now calculate checksums for a list of objects using supported algorithms in Amazon S3, without requiring a restore or download
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.151.0): Customer managed keys now available for volume encryption of SageMaker HyperPod clusters.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.93.1): Added default_x86_64 and default_arm64 as values to the instanceTypes field.

August 15th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amp` (1.85.0): Add Resource-based Policy APIs for Amazon Prometheus
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.111.0): This release adds support for saving Bedrock Flows while node configuration is still in progress, even if the Flow is not yet able to be invoked
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.116.0): AWS Glue Zero ETL now supports On-demand snapshot load

August 14th, 2025
=================
**New this release:**
- :bug: pin crc-fast to <1.4 to workaround SIGILL

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-arcregionswitch` (1.3.0): Endpoint rule test and documentation update.
- `aws-sdk-bcmrecommendedactions` (1.0.0): Initial SDK release for AWS Billing and Cost Management Recommended Actions.
- `aws-sdk-directconnect` (1.85.0): Added pagination support for DescribeHostedConnections, DescribeVirtualInterfaces, DescribeConnections, DescribeInterconnects, DescribeLags. Added asnLong support for BGP peer operations which supports a large range.
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.89.0): This release 1/ Adds support for throttled keys mode for CloudWatch Contributor Insights, 2/ Adds throttling reasons to exceptions across dataplane APIs. 3/ Explicitly models ThrottlingException as a class in statically typed languages. Refer to the launch day blog post for more details.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.159.0): This release adds ModifyInstanceConnectEndpoint API to update configurations on existing EC2 Instance Connect Endpoints and improves IPv6 support through dualstack DNS names for EC2 Instance Connect Endpoints.
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.91.0): Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 2nd generation file systems now support decreasing SSD storage capacity.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.115.0): AWS Glue now supports Trusted Identity Propagation.
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.94.0): Added support for entity lists.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.103.0): CMAF Ingest output groups in MediaLive can now accept one additional destination url for single pipeline channels and up to two additional destination urls for standard channels.
- `aws-sdk-pcs` (1.48.0): Updated the regex pattern and description of iamInstanceProfileArn in the CreateComputeNodeGroup and UpdateComputeNodeGroup API actions. Name and path requirements apply to the ARN of the IAM role associated with the instance profile and not the ARN of the instance profile.
- `aws-sdk-servicediscovery` (1.82.0): Added support for cross account through Id parameter overloading with ARN and allow owner account for some APIs instead of ARN
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.96.0): New APIs introduced to import WorkSpaces BYOL image using a new process that leveraged EC2 Image Builder. WorkSpaces tests and fixes your image's compatibility issues and supports customized VM images.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-qapps` (1.49.0): Documentation update for Amazon Q Apps API Reference

August 13th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-braket` (1.83.0): Add support for Braket program sets.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.97.0): Adds support for account pools and project profile account decoupling
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.90.0): Add Dual-Stack support for Amazon FSx for OpenZFS file systems
- `aws-sdk-partnercentralselling` (1.35.0): Add Tagging Support for Opportunity resources
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.149.0): This release introduces compute quota for GPU, Trainium accelerators, vCPU, and vCPU memory utilization across teams in HyperPod clusters
- `aws-sdk-securityir` (1.34.0): Added support for Organizational Unit-level Membership configuration and the ability to resume a cancelled membership.

August 12th, 2025
=================
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#4208](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4208)) Add the ability to insert `hints.mostly-unused = true` in Cargo.toml. Enable this hint for the below crates:
    - aws-sdk-cloudformation
    - aws-sdk-dynamodb
    - aws-sdk-ec2
    - aws-sdk-s3
    - aws-sdk-sns
    - aws-sdk-sqs
    - aws-sdk-ssm
    - aws-sdk-sts

    See more information about this hint at https://blog.rust-lang.org/inside-rust/2025/07/15/call-for-testing-hint-mostly-unused/
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#4208](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4208), @joshtriplett) Enable `hints.mostly-unused = true` for `aws-sdk-lambda` (taking a release
    build from 57s to 40s) and `aws-sdk-rds` (taking a release build from 1m34s to
    49s).

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-backupsearch` (1.30.0): Using recommended smithy trait to generate regional endpoints for Backup Search
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.104.0): AWS CodeBuild now supports PullRequestBuildPolicy in webhook object.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.158.0): Release to allow route table association with a PublicIpv4Pool.
- `aws-sdk-organizations` (1.89.0): This release introduces 2 new APIs in Organizations: 1. ListAccountsWithInvalidEffectivePolicy 2. ListEffectivePolicyValidationErrors
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.148.0): IAM Identity Center trusted identity propagation is now supported in SageMaker Studio.
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.85.0): AWS HealthScribe now supports specifying preferred patient pronouns through the MedicalScribeContext parameter for use in the generated clinical notes.
- `aws-sdk-transcribestreaming` (1.82.0): AWS HealthScribe now supports specifying preferred patient pronouns through the MedicalScribeContext parameter for use in the generated clinical notes.

**Contributors**
Thank you for your contributions! ❤
- @joshtriplett ([smithy-rs#4208](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4208))

August 11th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.108.0): This release includes model updates and enhanced SDK documentation for union fields in automated reasoning policy components. Added docs cover policy definitions, mutations (add/update for rules/types/variables), build assets, workflow sources, test results, and tag exception handling.
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.93.0): Remove SigV4 auth requirement for GetTokensFromRefreshToken
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.120.0): Updating SearchUserHierarchyGroups API
- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.73.0): Adds support for Wait and Save feature in service-managed fleets
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.157.0): This release adds AvailabilityZoneId support for CreateVolume, DescribeVolume, LaunchTemplates, RunInstances, DescribeInstances, CreateDefaultSubnet, SpotInstances, and CreateDefaultSubnet APIs.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.100.0): Add RowAxisDisplayOptions and ColumnAxisDisplayOptions to HeatMapConfiguration, add Actions to PluginVisual, increase limit for CalculatedFields list
- `aws-sdk-ssoadmin` (1.80.0): Added support for managing user background session for applications

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-evs` (1.8.1): Update for general availability of Amazon Elastic VMware Service (EVS).
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.92.1): Doc-only update for Lambda that updates the maximum payload size for response streaming invocations to 200 MB.

August 8th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-applicationsignals` (1.56.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-backupsearch` (1.29.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-bcmpricingcalculator` (1.35.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-billing` (1.32.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.119.0): This release adds a new API GetContactMetrics for Amazon Connect.
- `aws-sdk-dsql` (1.34.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-gameliftstreams` (1.20.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-inspector2` (1.89.0): Add CVSSV4 to Vulnerability Search API and update enable/disable account id list length to 5
- `aws-sdk-invoicing` (1.31.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-iotdataplane` (1.80.0): Adding DeleteConnection API to IoT Data Plane
- `aws-sdk-iotmanagedintegrations` (1.21.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-keyspacesstreams` (1.7.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-mpa` (1.7.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-networkflowmonitor` (1.33.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-notifications` (1.32.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-notificationscontacts` (1.31.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-partnercentralselling` (1.33.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-s3vectors` (1.5.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.147.0): Adds support for GB200 UltraServers in Amazon SageMaker training jobs, training plans, and HyperPod clusters
- `aws-sdk-securityir` (1.32.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests
- `aws-sdk-workspacesinstances` (1.7.0): Removed incorrect endpoint tests

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.84.1): Update documentation to use key ARN only in OutputEncryptionKMSKeyId request parameter

August 7th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.89.0): Added new viewer security policy, TLSv1.3_2025, for CloudFront.
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.103.0): AWS CodeBuild now supports comment-based pull request control.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.113.0): AWS Glue Data Catalog now supports Iceberg Optimization settings at the Catalog level, and supports new options to control the optimization job run rate.
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.92.0): Added support for VPC owner account ID associated with DNS request in the GuardDuty finding.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.91.1): This feature allows customers to use AWS Batch with Linux with ARM64 CPU Architecture with Fargate Spot compute support.
- `aws-sdk-gameliftstreams` (1.19.1): Adds Proton 9.0-2 to the list of runtime environment options available when creating an Amazon GameLift Streams application

August 6th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.83.0): Adds support for billing views. Billing views let you control access to cost and usage data through an AWS resource, streamlining the process of sharing cost and usage data across account boundaries. With this release, you can now create and view budgets based on billing views.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.156.0): Mark Elastic Inference Accelerators and Elastic Graphics Processor parameters as deprecated on the RunInstances and LaunchTemplate APIs.
- `aws-sdk-opensearchserverless` (1.85.0): Features: add Index APIs in OpenSearchServerless to support managed semantic enrichment
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.94.0): Amazon Q Business now supports the GetDocumentContent() API that enables customers to securely access the source documents through clickable citation links at query time

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.85.1): Added support for G6 instances

August 5th, 2025
================
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#4241](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4241)) Add support for environment token provider for AWS services whose SigV4 service signing name matches `bedrock`. Setting this environment variable, `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`, allows SDKs to prefer the `httpBearerAuth` auth scheme and to retrieve a Token value from the said environment. Customers would use the environment variable as follows:
    ```
    // export AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK=my-token
    let sdk_config = aws_config::defaults(BehaviorVersion::latest()).load().await;
    let bedrock_client = aws_sdk_bedrock::Client::new(&sdk_config);
    // call an operation on `bedrock_client`...
    ```
    Under the hood, this is equivalent roughly to
    ```
    let sdk_config = aws_config::defaults(BehaviorVersion::latest()).load().await;
    let bedrock_config = aws_sdk_bedrock::config::Builder::from(sdk_config)
        .auth_scheme_preference([HTTP_BEARER_AUTH_SCHEME_ID])
        .token_provider(Token::new("my-token", None))
        .build();
    let bedrock_client = aws_sdk_bedrock::Client::from_conf(bedrock_config);
    // call an operation on `bedrock_client`...
    ```
    However, note that if customers create the service client directly from the service config builder, the environment variable will not be applied:
    ```
    // export AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK=my-token
    let bedrock_config = aws_sdk_bedrock::Config::builder()
        // other configurations
        .build();
    let bedrock_client = aws_sdk_bedrock::Client::from_conf(bedrock_config);
    // `bedrock_client` neither prefers HTTP_BEARER_AUTH_SCHEME_ID nor sets a Token with my-token.
    ```
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#4238](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4238)) Add user-agent feature tracking for credential providers in `aws-config`.
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#4227](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4227)) Fix canonical request sort order

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.107.0): This release introduces Automated Reasoning checks for Amazon Bedrock Guardrails. The feature adds new APIs for policy building, refinement, version management, and testing. Guardrail APIs now support Automated Reasoning policy configuration and validation output.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.100.0): This release adds support for Automated Reasoning checks output models for the Amazon Bedrock Guardrails ApplyGuardrail API.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.100.0): Add support for deletion protection on EKS clusters
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.101.0): Adds a new Aurora Serverless v2 attribute to the DBCluster resource to expose the platform version. Also updates the attribute to be part of both the engine version and platform version descriptions.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.146.0): Add support for SageMaker Hyperpod continuous scaling and custom AMI; Introduce new APIs: ListClusterEvents, DescribeClusterEvent, BatchAddClusterNodes

August 4th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcore` (1.3.0): Remove superfluous field from API
- `aws-sdk-codeconnections` (1.62.0): New integration with Azure DevOps provider type.
- `aws-sdk-evs` (1.7.0): TagResource API now throws ServiceQuotaExceededException when the number of tags on the Amazon EVS resource exceeds the maximum allowed. TooManyTagsException is deprecated.
- `aws-sdk-iotsitewise` (1.84.0): Support Interface for IoT SiteWise Asset Modeling
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.145.0): This release adds the ability for customers to attach and detach their EBS volumes to EKS-orchestrated HyperPod cluster nodes.

August 1st, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-aiops` (1.7.0): This release includes fix for InvestigationGroup timestamp conversion issue.
- `aws-sdk-arcregionswitch` (1.0.0): This is the initial SDK release for Region switch
- `aws-sdk-auditmanager` (1.82.0): Added a note to Framework APIs (CreateAssessmentFramework, GetAssessmentFramework, UpdateAssessmentFramework) clarifying that the Controls object returns a partial response when called through Framework APIs. Added documentation that the Framework's controlSources parameter is no longer supported.
- `aws-sdk-lightsail` (1.83.0): This release adds support for the Asia Pacific (Jakarta) (ap-southeast-3) Region.
- `aws-sdk-observabilityadmin` (1.30.0): CloudWatch Observability Admin adds the ability to enable telemetry on AWS resources such as Amazon VPCs (Flow Logs) in customers AWS Accounts and Organizations. The release introduces new APIs to manage telemetry rules, which define telemetry settings to be applied on AWS resources.
- `aws-sdk-pcs` (1.45.0): Add support for IPv6 Networking for Clusters.
- `aws-sdk-securityhub` (1.85.0): Release new resource detail type CodeRepository

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-acmpca` (1.83.1): Doc-only update to add more information to GetCertificate action.
- `aws-sdk-sns` (1.79.1): Amazon SNS support for Amazon SQS fair queues

July 31st, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-customerprofiles` (1.86.0): The release updates standard profile with 2 new fields that supports account-level engagement. Updated APIs include CreateProfile, UpdateProfile, MergeProfiles, SearchProfiles, BatchGetProfile, GetSegmentMembership, CreateSegmentDefinition, CreateSegmentEstimate.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.154.0): Added support for the force option for the EC2 instance terminate command. This feature enables customers to recover resources associated with an instance stuck in the shutting-down state as a result of rare issues caused by a frozen operating system or an underlying hardware problem.
- `aws-sdk-entityresolution` (1.86.0): Add support for creating advanced rule-based matching workflows in AWS Entity Resolution.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.111.0): Added support for Route node, S3 Iceberg sources/targets, catalog Iceberg sources, DynamoDB ELT connector, AutoDataQuality evaluation, enhanced PII detection with redaction, Kinesis fan-out support, and new R-series worker types.
- `aws-sdk-inspector2` (1.87.0): Extend usage to include agentless hours and add CODE_REPOSITORY to aggregation resource type
- `aws-sdk-iot` (1.89.0): This release allows AWS IoT Core users to use their own AWS KMS keys for data protection
- `aws-sdk-opensearch` (1.92.0): Granular access control support for NEO-SAML with IAMFederation for AOS data source
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.98.0): Added Impala connector support
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.91.0): Add Tags field to CreateAccessPoint
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.91.0): This release introduces support for Multi-tenant management
- `aws-sdk-workspacesweb` (1.84.0): Added ability to log session activity on a portal to an S3 bucket.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-elasticloadbalancingv2` (1.88.1): This release enables secondary IP addresses for Network Load Balancers.

July 30th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.87.0): This release adds new origin timeout options: 1) ResponseCompletionTimeout and 2) OriginReadTimeout (for S3 origins)
- `aws-sdk-directory` (1.81.0): This release adds support for AWS Managed Microsoft AD Hybrid Edition, introducing new operations: StartADAssessment, DescribeADAssessment, ListADAssessments, DeleteADAssessment, CreateHybridAD, UpdateHybridAD, and DescribeHybridADUpdate; and updated existing operation: DescribeDirectories.
- `aws-sdk-docdb` (1.83.0): Add support for setting Serverless Scaling Configuration on clusters.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.153.0): Release to show the next hop IP address for routes propagated by VPC Route Server into VPC route tables.
- `aws-sdk-iotwireless` (1.84.0): Added TxPowerIndexMin, TxPowerIndexMax, NbTransMin and NbTransMax params to ServiceProfile.

July 29th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.90.0): AWS Batch for SageMaker Training jobs feature support.  Includes new APIs for service job submission (e.g., SubmitServiceJob) and managing service environments (e.g., CreateServiceEnvironment) that enable queueing SageMaker Training jobs.
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.90.0): This feature provides the ability to update the table reference and allowed columns on an existing configured table.
- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.71.0): Adds support for tag management on monitors.
- `aws-sdk-location` (1.83.0): This release 1) adds support for multi-polygon geofences with disconnected territories, and 2) enables polygon exclusion zones within geofences for more accurate representation of real-world boundaries.
- `aws-sdk-opensearchserverless` (1.83.0): This is to support Granular access control support for SAML with IAMFedraton in AOSS

July 28th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-directconnect` (1.82.0): Enable MACSec support and features on Interconnects.
- `aws-sdk-iotsitewise` (1.83.0): Add support for native anomaly detection in IoT SiteWise using new Computation Model APIs
- `aws-sdk-osis` (1.81.0): Add Pipeline Role Arn as an optional parameter to the create / update pipeline APIs as an alternative to passing in the pipeline configuration body

July 25th, 2025
===============
**New this release:**
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#4232](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4232)) Add fallback equality on no auth `AuthSchemeId` for backward compatibility, treating `AuthSchemeId::from("no_auth")` (legacy) and `AuthSchemeId::from("noAuth")` (updated) as equivalent.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appintegrations` (1.79.0): Amazon AppIntegrations introduces new configuration capabilities to enable customers to manage iframe permissions, control application refresh behavior (per contact or per browser/cross-contact), and run background applications (service).
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.81.0): Adds IPv6 and PrivateLink support for AWS Budgets in IAD.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.152.0): Transit Gateway native integration with AWS Network Firewall. Adding new enum value for the new Transit Gateway Attachment type.
- `aws-sdk-mediapackagev2` (1.87.0): This release adds support for specifying a preferred input for channels using CMAF ingest.
- `aws-sdk-socialmessaging` (1.33.0): This release introduces new WhatsApp template management APIs that enable customers to programmatically create and submit templates for approval, monitor approval status, and manage the complete template lifecycle

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-config` (1.82.0): Documentation improvements have been made to the EvaluationModel and DescribeConfigurationRecorders APIs.
- `aws-sdk-kms` (1.81.0): Doc only update: fixed grammatical errors.
- `aws-sdk-sqs` (1.78.0): Documentation updates for Amazon SQS fair queues feature.

July 24th, 2025
===============
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#4203](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4203)) Add support for configuring auth schemes manually using an auth scheme preference list.
    The preference list allows customers to reprioritize the order of auth schemes originally
    determined by the auth scheme resolver.
    Customers can configure the auth scheme preference at the following locations, listed in order of precedence:
    1. Service Client Configuration
    ```rust
    use aws_runtime::auth::sigv4;
    use aws_smithy_runtime_api::client::auth::AuthSchemeId;
    use aws_smithy_runtime_api::client::auth::http::HTTP_BEARER_AUTH_SCHEME_ID;

    let config = aws_sdk_s3::Config::builder()
        .auth_scheme_preference([AuthSchemeId::from("scheme1"), sigv4::SCHEME_ID, HTTP_BEARER_AUTH_SCHEME_ID])
        // ...
        .build();
    ```
    2. Environment Variable
    ```
    AWS_AUTH_SCHEME_PREFERENCE=scheme1, sigv4, httpBearerAuth
    ```
    3. Configuration File
    ```
    auth_scheme_preference=scheme1, sigv4, httpBearerAuth
    ```
    With this configuration, the auth scheme resolver will prefer to select them in the specified order,
    if they are supported.
- ([smithy-rs#4212](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4212)) Event streams now allocate a right-sized buffer avoiding repeated reallocations during serialization

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.93.0): This release adds support for 1) highlighting relevant text in returned results for Search and SearchListings APIs and 2) returning aggregated counts of values for specified attributes for SearchListings API.
- `aws-sdk-omics` (1.83.0): Add Git integration and README support for HealthOmics workflows

July 23rd, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.150.0): Added support for skip-os-shutdown option for the EC2 instance stop and terminate operations. This feature enables customers to bypass the graceful OS shutdown, supporting faster state transitions when instance data preservation isn't critical.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.108.0): AWS Glue now supports dynamic session policies for job executions. This feature allows you to specify custom, fine-grained permissions for each job run without creating multiple IAM roles.
- `aws-sdk-workspacesthinclient` (1.82.0): Added the lastUserId parameter to the ListDevices and GetDevice API.

July 22nd, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.85.0): Add support for Image Tag Mutability Exception feature, allowing repositories to define wildcard-based patterns that override the default image tag mutability settings.
- `aws-sdk-emr` (1.83.0): This release adds new parameter 'ExtendedSupport' in AWS EMR RunJobFlow, ModifyCluster and DescribeCluster API.
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.89.0): This release migrated the model to Smithy keeping all features unchanged.
- `aws-sdk-neptunedata` (1.77.0): This release updates the supported regions for Neptune API to include current AWS regions.

July 21st, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.84.0): Add dualstack endpoint support
- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.68.0): Add support for VPC resource endpoints in Service Managed Fleets
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.149.0): This release adds support for C8gn, F2 and P6e-GB200 Instance types
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.142.0): This release adds 1/ Support for S3FileSystem in CustomFileSystems 2/ The ability for a customer to select their preferred IpAddressType for use with private Workforces 3/ Support for p4de instance type in SageMaker Training Plans
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.64.0): Timestream for InfluxDB adds support for db.influx.24xlarge instance type. This enhancement enables higher compute capacity for demanding workloads through CreateDbInstance, CreateDbCluster, UpdateDbInstance, and UpdateDbCluster APIs.

July 18th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-auditmanager` (1.79.0): Updated error handling for RegisterOrganizationAdminAccount API to properly translate TooManyExceptions to HTTP 429 status code. This enhancement improves error handling consistency and provides clearer feedback when request limits are exceeded.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.94.0): CloudWatchLogs launches GetLogObject API with streaming support for efficient log data retrieval. Logs added support for new AccountPolicy type METRIC_EXTRACTION_POLICY. For more information, see CloudWatch Logs API documentation
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.96.0): This release adds support for TAMS server integration with MediaConvert inputs.
- `aws-sdk-outposts` (1.85.0): Add AWS Outposts API to surface customer billing information
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.88.0): Added IP Visibility support for managed dedicated pools. Enhanced GetDedicatedIp and GetDedicatedIps APIs to return managed IP addresses.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ssm` (1.85.1): July 2025 doc-only updates for Systems Manager.

July 17th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanroomsml` (1.78.0): This release introduces Parquet result format support for ML Input Channel models in AWS Clean Rooms ML.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.148.0): AWS Free Tier Version2 Support
- `aws-sdk-mailmanager` (1.59.0): Allow underscores in the local part of the input of the "Email recipients rewrite" action in rule sets.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.95.0): This release expands the range of supported audio outputs to include xHE, 192khz FLAC and the deprecation of dual mono for AC3.
- `aws-sdk-synthetics` (1.84.0): This feature allows AWS Synthetics customers to provide code dependencies using lambda layer while creating a canary

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.83.1): Doc only update for CloudFront that fixes some customer-reported issues
- `aws-sdk-keyspacesstreams` (1.3.1): Doc only update for the Amazon Keyspaces Streams API.
- `aws-sdk-sfn` (1.80.1): Align input with style guidelines.

July 16th, 2025
===============
**New this release:**
- re-use checksums on retry attempts for enhanced durability

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.104.0): This release adds support for on-demand custom model inference through CustomModelDeployment APIs for Amazon Bedrock.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcore` (1.0.0): Initial release of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore SDK including Runtime, Built-In Tools, Memory, Gateway and Identity.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentcorecontrol` (1.0.0): Initial release of Amazon Bedrock AgentCore SDK including Runtime, Built-In Tools, Memory, Gateway and Identity.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.97.0): document update to support on demand custom model.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.93.0): CloudWatch Logs updates: Added X-Ray tracing for Amazon Bedrock Agent resources. Logs introduced Log Group level resource policies (managed through Put/Delete/Describe Resource Policy APIs). For more information, see CloudWatch Logs API documentation.
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.83.0): AWS DataSync now supports IPv6 address inputs and outputs in create, update, and describe operations for NFS, SMB, and Object Storage locations
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.107.0): AWS Glue now supports schema, partition and sort management of Apache Iceberg tables using Glue SDK
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.88.0): Add expectedBucketOwner parameter to ThreatIntel and IPSet APIs.
- `aws-sdk-iotwireless` (1.81.0): FuotaTaskId is not a valid IdentifierType for EventConfiguration and is being removed from possible IdentifierType values.
- `aws-sdk-mediapackagev2` (1.85.0): This release adds support for CDN Authentication using Static Headers in MediaPackage v2.
- `aws-sdk-networkflowmonitor` (1.29.0): Introducing 2 new scope status types - DEACTIVATING and DEACTIVATED.
- `aws-sdk-paymentcryptographydata` (1.81.0): Expand length of message data field for Mac generation and validation to 8192 characters.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-sfn` (1.80.0): Doc-only update to introduction, and edits to clarify input parameter and the set of control characters.

July 15th, 2025
===============
**New this release:**
- ([smithy-rs#4076](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4076), [smithy-rs#4198](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4198)) Allows customers to configure the auth schemes and auth scheme resolver. For more information see the GitHub [discussion](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/discussions/4197).

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.104.0): Add support for S3 Vectors as a vector store.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.91.0): Removing restriction of environment profile identifier as required field, S3 feature release
- `aws-sdk-dynamodbstreams` (1.75.0): Added support for optional shard filter parameter in DescribeStream api that allows customers to fetch child shards of a read_only parent shard.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.146.0): This release adds support for volume initialization status, which enables you to monitor when the initialization process for an EBS volume is completed. This release also adds IPv6 support to EC2 Instance Connect Endpoints, allowing you to connect to your EC2 Instance via a private IPv6 address.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.87.0): Amazon ECS supports native blue/green deployments, allowing you to validate new service revisions before directing production traffic to them.
- `aws-sdk-eventbridge` (1.82.0): Add customer-facing logging for the EventBridge Event Bus, enabling customers to better observe their events and extract insights about their EventBridge usage.
- `aws-sdk-opensearch` (1.88.0): AWS Opensearch adds support for enabling s3 vector engine options. After enabling this option, customers will be able to create indices with s3 vector engine.
- `aws-sdk-pricing` (1.78.0): This release adds support for new filter types in GetProducts API, including EQUALS, CONTAINS, ANY_OF, and NONE_OF.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.94.0): Introduced custom instructions for topics.
- `aws-sdk-repostspace` (1.74.0): This release introduces Channels functionality with CreateChannel, GetChannel, ListChannels, and UpdateChannel operations. Channels provide dedicated collaboration spaces where teams can organize discussions and knowledge by projects, business units, or areas of responsibility.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.97.0): Amazon S3 Metadata live inventory tables provide a queryable inventory of all the objects in your general purpose bucket so that you can determine the latest state of your data. To help minimize your storage costs, use journal table record expiration to set a retention period for your records.
- `aws-sdk-s3tables` (1.29.0): Adds table bucket type to ListTableBucket and GetTableBucket API operations
- `aws-sdk-s3vectors` (1.0.0): Amazon S3 Vectors provides cost-effective, elastic, and durable vector storage for queries based on semantic meaning and similarity.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.140.0): This release adds support for a new Restricted instance group type to enable a specialized environment for running Nova customization jobs on SageMaker HyperPod clusters. This release also adds support for SageMaker pipeline versioning.

July 9th, 2025
==============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.145.0): Adds support to Capacity Blocks for ML for purchasing EC2 P6e-GB200 UltraServers. Customers can now purchase u-p6e-gb200x72 and u-p6e-gb200x36 UltraServers. Adds new DescribeCapacityBlocks andDescribeCapacityBlockStatus APIs. Adds support for CapacityBlockId to DescribeInstanceTopology.
- `aws-sdk-freetier` (1.73.0): This release introduces four new APIs: GetAccountPlanState and UpgradeAccountPlan for AWS account plan management; ListAccountActivities and GetAccountActivity that provide activity tracking capabilities.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-opsworkscm` (1.74.1): Removing content that refers to an S3 bucket that is no longer in use.

July 3rd, 2025
==============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-customerprofiles` (1.81.0): This release introduces capability of create Segments via importing a CSV file directly. This consumes the CSV file and creates/updates corresponding profiles for the particular domain.
- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.65.0): Added fields for output manifest reporting and task chunking parameters
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.144.0): This release adds GroupOwnerId as a response member to the DescribeSecurityGroupVpcAssociations API and also adds waiters for SecurityGroupVpcAssociations (SecurityGroupVpcAssociationAssociated and SecurityGroupVpcAssociationDisassociated).
- `aws-sdk-mediapackagev2` (1.83.0): This release adds support for Microsoft Smooth Streaming (MSS) and allows users to exclude DRM segment Metadata in MediaPackage v2 Origin Endpoints
- `aws-sdk-route53` (1.84.0): Amazon Route 53 now supports the iso-e regions for private DNS Amazon VPCs and cloudwatch healthchecks.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.139.0): Changes include new StartSession API for SageMaker Studio spaces and CreateHubContentPresignedUrls API for SageMaker JumpStart.

July 2nd, 2025
==============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-connectcases` (1.81.0): This release adds DeleteCase and DeleteRelatedItem APIs, which enable deleting cases and comments, undoing contact association, and removing service level agreements (SLAs) from cases. Contact center admins can use these APIs to delete cases when requested by customers and correct agent errors.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.143.0): AWS Site-to-Site VPN now supports IPv6 addresses on outer tunnel IPs, making it easier for customers to build or transition to IPv6-only networks.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.96.0): Added support for directory bucket creation with tags and bucket ARN retrieval in CreateBucket, ListDirectoryBuckets, and HeadBucket operations
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.86.0): Added TagResource, UntagResource, and ListTagsForResource support for directory bucket

July 1st, 2025
==============
**New this release:**
- ([smithy-rs#4187](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4187)) Temporarily disable fetching account ID from IMDS credentials on EC2.
- :bug: Fix hyper 1.x connection refused errors not marked as retryable
- ([smithy-rs#4186](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/4186)) Make Rpc V2 CBOR a compatible protocol for `awsQuery` using `awsQueryCompatible` trait

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cleanroomsml` (1.75.0): This release introduces support for incremental training and distributed training for custom models in AWS Clean Rooms ML.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.90.0): Add support for the new optional domain-unit-id parameter in the UpdateProject API.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.142.0): Add Context to GetInstanceTypesFromInstanceRequirements API
- `aws-sdk-odb` (1.0.0): This release adds API operations for Oracle Database@AWS. You can use the APIs to create Exadata infrastructure, ODB networks, and Exadata and Autonomous VM clusters inside AWS data centers. The infrastructure is managed by OCI. You can integrate these resources with AWS services.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.88.0): New ChatResponseConfiguration to Customize Q Business chat responses for specific use cases and communication needs. Updated Boosting capability allowing admins to provide preference on date attributes for recency and/or provide a preferred data source.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.138.0): Updated field validation requirements for InstanceGroups.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.96.0): Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle now supports multi-AZ database instances.
