March 13th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-acmpca` (1.67.0): Private Certificate Authority service now supports P521 and RSA3072 key algorithms.
- `aws-sdk-amplify` (1.69.0): Introduced support for Skew Protection. Added enableSkewProtection field to createBranch and updateBranch API.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.74.0): Updated CreateLogAnomalyDetector to accept only kms key arn
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.81.0): AWS CodeBuild now supports webhook filtering by organization name
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.76.0): This release adds support to update projects and environments
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.69.0): Generate account endpoints for DynamoDB requests using ARN-sourced account ID when available
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.118.0): This release changes the CreateLaunchTemplate, CreateLaunchTemplateVersion, ModifyLaunchTemplate CLI and SDKs such that if you do not specify a client token, a randomly generated token is used for the request to ensure idempotency.
- `aws-sdk-ivsrealtime` (1.70.0): IVS Real-Time now offers customers the ability to adjust the participant & composition recording segment duration
- `aws-sdk-mediapackagev2` (1.69.0): This release adds the ResetChannelState and ResetOriginEndpointState operation to reset MediaPackage V2 channel and origin endpoint. This release also adds a new field, UrlEncodeChildManifest, for HLS/LL-HLS to allow URL-encoding child manifest query string based on the requirements of AWS SigV4.
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.69.0): Updating GetDataAccess response for S3 Access Grants to include the matched Grantee for the requested prefix

March 11th, 2025
================
**New this release:**
- ([aws-sdk-rust#977](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/977), [smithy-rs#1925](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/1925), [smithy-rs#3710](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/3710)) Updates the default HTTP client to be based on the 1.x version of hyper and updates the default TLS provider to [rustls](https://github.com/rustls/rustls) with [aws-lc](https://github.com/aws/aws-lc-rs). For more information see the GitHub [discussion](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/discussions/1257).

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.117.0): This release adds the GroupLongName field to the response of the DescribeAvailabilityZones API.
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.68.0): This release adds Amazon ECR to Amazon ECR pull through cache rules support.
- `aws-sdk-inspector2` (1.69.0): Adding componentArn to network reachability details
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.79.0): Add an enum option DISABLED for Output Locking Mode under Global Configuration.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.70.0): This is a documentation only update for Amazon ECS to address various tickets.

March 10th, 2025
================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.85.0): Add support for computer use tools
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.84.0): Add support for computer use tools
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.95.0): Add support for contact transfers in external voice systems.
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.68.0): Releasing minor partition endpoint updates.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.78.0): Adds defaultFontSize and defaultLineHeight as options in the EbuTtDDestinationSettings within the caption descriptions for an output stream.
- `aws-sdk-pcaconnectorad` (1.62.0): PrivateCA Connector for Active Directory now supports dual stack endpoints. This release adds the IpAddressType option to the VpcInformation on a Connector which determines whether the endpoint supports IPv4 only or IPv4 and IPv6 traffic.
- `aws-sdk-securityhub` (1.66.0): This release adds new StandardsControlsUpdatable field to the StandardsSubscription resource

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.48.1): This release updates the default value of pprof-disabled from false to true.

March 7th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.84.0): Introduces support for Neptune Analytics as a vector data store and adds Context Enrichment Configurations, enabling use cases such as GraphRAG.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.83.0): Support Multi Agent Collaboration within Inline Agents
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.116.0): Add serviceManaged field to DescribeAddresses API response.
- `aws-sdk-elasticloadbalancingv2` (1.70.0): This release adds support for assigning IP addresses to Application Load Balancers from VPC IP Address Manager pools.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.67.1): Documentation updates for Amazon CloudFront.
- `aws-sdk-neptunegraph` (1.60.1): Several small updates to resolve customer requests.

March 6th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.77.0): This releases adds support for Custom Prompt Router
- `aws-sdk-ivsrealtime` (1.68.0): IVS Real-Time now offers customers the ability to merge fragmented recordings in the event of a participant disconnect.
- `aws-sdk-networkflowmonitor` (1.13.0): This release contains 2 changes. 1: DeleteScope/GetScope/UpdateScope operations now return 404 instead of 500 when the resource does not exist. 2: Expected string format for clientToken fields of CreateMonitorInput/CreateScopeInput/UpdateMonitorInput have been updated to be an UUID based string.
- `aws-sdk-redshiftdata` (1.64.0): This release adds support for ListStatements API to filter statements by ClusterIdentifier, WorkgroupName, and Database.
- `aws-sdk-wafv2` (1.68.0): You can now perform an exact match or rate limit aggregation against the web request's JA4 fingerprint.
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.73.0): Added a new ModifyEndpointEncryptionMode API for managing endpoint encryption settings.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudtrail` (1.67.1): Doc-only update for CloudTrail.

**New this release:**
- :tada: ([aws-sdk-rust#213](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/213), [aws-sdk-rust#1188](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1188)) Adds support for event stream operations with non-REST protocols such as AWS JSON. This update enables operations, including `SubscribeToShard` in Kinesis and `StartLiveTail` in CloudWatchLogs in the Rust SDK.
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#920](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/920)) Add missing `request_checksum_calculation` and `response_checksum_validation` setters to the `ConfigLoader`

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.76.0): This releases adds support for Custom Prompt Router ARN
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.67.0): AWS DataSync now supports modifying ServerHostname while updating locations SMB, NFS, and ObjectStorage.
- `aws-sdk-gameliftstreams` (1.0.0): New Service: Amazon GameLift Streams delivers low-latency game streaming from AWS global infrastructure to virtually any device with a browser at up to 1080p resolution and 60 fps.
- `aws-sdk-iotfleetwise` (1.66.0): This release adds floating point support for CAN/OBD signals and adds support for signed OBD signals.
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.72.0): Added DeviceTypeWorkSpacesThinClient type to allow users to access their WorkSpaces through a WorkSpaces Thin Client.

March 4th, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-iotmanagedintegrations` (1.0.0): Adding managed integrations APIs for IoT Device Management to setup and control devices across different manufacturers and connectivity protocols. APIs include managedthing operations, credential and provisioning profile management, notification configuration, and OTA update.
- `aws-sdk-iotsitewise` (1.64.0): AWS IoT SiteWise now supports MQTT-enabled, V3 gateways. Configure data destinations for real-time ingestion into AWS IoT SiteWise or buffered ingestion using Amazon S3 storage. You can also use path filters for precise data collection from specific MQTT topics.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-elasticache` (1.65.1): Doc only update, listing 'valkey7' and 'valkey8' as engine options for parameter groups.

March 3rd, 2025
===============
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.71.0): Added the capacity to return available challenges in admin authentication and to set version 3 of the pre token generation event for M2M ATC.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.114.0): Update the DescribeVpcs response
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.70.0): Adds support for the ingestion of audio and video files by Q Business, which can be configured with the mediaExtractionConfiguration parameter.
- `aws-sdk-rum` (1.61.0): Add support for PutResourcePolicy, GetResourcePolicy and DeleteResourcePolicy to support resource based policies for AWS CloudWatch RUM
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.109.0): Add DomainId to CreateDomainResponse

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.63.1): Updating documentation for post call analytics job queueing.

February 28th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.82.0): This release lets Amazon Bedrock Flows support newer models by increasing the maximum length of output in a prompt configuration. This release also increases the maximum number of prompt variables to 20 and the maximum number of node inputs to 20.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomation` (1.11.0): Renamed and added new StandardConfiguration enums. Added support to update EncryptionConfiguration in UpdateBlueprint and UpdateDataAutomation APIs. Changed HttpStatus code for DeleteBlueprint and DeleteDataAutomationProject APIs to 200 from 204. Added APIs to support tagging.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomationruntime` (1.11.0): Added a mandatory parameter DataAutomationProfileArn to support for cross region inference for InvokeDataAutomationAsync API. Renamed DataAutomationArn to DataAutomationProjectArn. Added APIs to support tagging.
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.67.0): Add skipped status to the Result Statistics of an Assessment Run
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.76.0): Adding licenses to EKS Anywhere Subscription operations response.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.74.0): The AWS MediaConvert Probe API allows you to analyze media files and retrieve detailed metadata about their content, format, and structure.
- `aws-sdk-pricing` (1.63.0): Update GetProducts and DescribeServices API request input validations.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ssm` (1.66.1): Systems Manager doc-only updates for Feb. 2025.

February 27th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.81.0): Introduces Sessions (preview) to enable stateful conversations in GenAI applications.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.69.0): This release supports deleting attachments from conversations.
- `aws-sdk-redshiftserverless` (1.64.0): Add track support for Redshift Serverless workgroup.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.108.0): SageMaker HubService is introducing support for creating Training Jobs in Curated Hub (Private Hub). Additionally, it is introducing two new APIs: UpdateHubContent and UpdateHubContentReference.
- `aws-sdk-storagegateway` (1.65.0): This release adds support to invoke a process that cleans the specified file share's cache of file entries that are failing upload to Amazon S3.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-emr` (1.66.1): Definition update for EbsConfiguration.

February 26th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-applicationsignals` (1.34.0): This release adds API support for reading Service Level Objectives and Services from monitoring accounts, from SLO and Service-scoped operations, including ListServices and ListServiceLevelObjectives.
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.70.0): AWS Batch: Resource Aware Scheduling feature support
- `aws-sdk-chime` (1.61.0): Removes the Amazon Chime SDK APIs from the "chime" namespace.  Amazon Chime SDK APIs continue to be available in the AWS SDK via the dedicated Amazon Chime SDK namespaces: chime-sdk-identity, chime-sdk-mediapipelines, chime-sdk-meetings, chime-sdk-messaging, and chime-sdk-voice.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.113.0): Amazon EC2 Fleet customers can now override the Block Device Mapping specified in the Launch Template when creating a new Fleet request, saving the effort of creating and associating new Launch Templates to customize the Block Device Mapping.
- `aws-sdk-iotfleetwise` (1.65.0): This release adds an optional listResponseScope request parameter in certain list API requests to limit the response to metadata only.
- `aws-sdk-oam` (1.63.0): This release adds support for sharing AWS::ApplicationSignals::Service and AWS::ApplicationSignals::ServiceLevelObjective resources.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.107.0): AWS SageMaker InferenceComponents now support rolling update deployments for Inference Components.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.66.1): Documentation update for VPC origin config.

February 25th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.78.0): Adding "reportArns" field in output of BatchGetBuildBatches API. "reportArns" is an array that contains the ARNs of reports created by merging reports from builds associated with the batch build.
- `aws-sdk-devicefarm` (1.63.0): Add an optional configuration to the ScheduleRun and CreateRemoteAccessSession API to set a device level http/s proxy.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.112.0): Adds support for time-based EBS-backed AMI copy operations. Time-based copy ensures that EBS-backed AMIs are copied within and across Regions in a specified timeframe.
- `aws-sdk-iot` (1.70.0): AWS IoT - AWS IoT Device Defender adds support for a new Device Defender Audit Check that monitors device certificate age and custom threshold configurations for both the new device certificate age check and existing device certificate expiry check.
- `aws-sdk-taxsettings` (1.35.0): PutTaxRegistration API changes for Egypt, Greece, Vietnam countries

February 24th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.81.0): This release improves support for newer models in Amazon Bedrock Flows.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.80.0): Adding support for ReasoningContent fields in Pre-Processing, Post-Processing and Orchestration Trace outputs.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.75.0): This release adds Reasoning Content support to Converse and ConverseStream APIs

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-elasticache` (1.65.0): Documentation update, adding clarity and rephrasing.

February 21st, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.65.0): Added support for Certificate-Based Authentication on AppStream 2.0 multi-session fleets.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.80.0): Introduce a new parameter which represents the user-agent header value used by the Bedrock Knowledge Base Web Connector.

February 20th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.76.0): Add webhook status and status message to AWS CodeBuild webhooks
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.69.0): Reduce the minimum number of required attack sequence signals from 2 to 1
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.105.0): Added new capability in the UpdateCluster operation to remove instance groups from your SageMaker HyperPod cluster.
- `aws-sdk-workspacesweb` (1.64.0): Add support for toolbar configuration under user settings.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-licensemanagerusersubscriptions` (1.60.1): Updates entity to include Microsoft RDS SAL as a valid type of user subscription.
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.78.1): CloudWatch Database Insights now supports Amazon RDS.

February 19th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-codepipeline` (1.69.0): Add environment variables to codepipeline action declaration.
- `aws-sdk-location` (1.63.0): Adds support for larger property maps for tracking and geofence positions changes. It increases the maximum number of items from 3 to 4, and the maximum value length from 40 to 150.
- `aws-sdk-mailmanager` (1.38.0): This release adds additional metadata fields in Mail Manager archive searches to show email source and details about emails that were archived when being sent with SES.
- `aws-sdk-networkfirewall` (1.62.0): This release introduces Network Firewall's Automated Domain List feature. New APIs include UpdateFirewallAnalysisSettings, StartAnalysisReport, GetAnalysisReportResults, and ListAnalysisReports. These allow customers to enable analysis on firewalls to identify and report frequently accessed domain.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.104.0): Adds r8g instance type support to SageMaker Realtime Endpoints
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.67.0): This release adds the ability for outbound email sent with SES to preserve emails to a Mail Manager archive.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.67.1): This is a documentation only release for Amazon ECS that supports the CPU task limit increase.
- `aws-sdk-lightsail` (1.63.1): Documentation updates for Amazon Lightsail.

February 18th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-emrcontainers` (1.64.0): EMR on EKS StartJobRun Api will be supporting the configuration of log storage in AWS by using "managedLogs" under "MonitoringConfiguration".
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.75.0): Adds support for creating CloudWatchAlarmTemplates for AWS Elemental MediaTailor Playback Configuration resources.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.68.1): This documentation-only update corrects some typos.

February 17th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amplify` (1.65.0): Add ComputeRoleArn to CreateApp, UpdateApp, CreateBranch, and UpdateBranch, allowing caller to specify a role to be assumed by Amplify Hosting for server-side rendered applications.
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.65.0): Support replicationConfigArn in DMS DescribeApplicableIndividualAssessments API.
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.46.0): This release introduces APIs to manage DbClusters and adds support for read replicas

February 14th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.75.0): Added test suite names to test case metadata
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.92.0): Release Notes: 1) Analytics API enhancements: Added new ListAnalyticsDataLakeDataSets API. 2)  Onboarding API Idempotency: Adds ClientToken to instance creation and management APIs to support idempotency.
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.64.0): Introduces premigration assessment feature to DMS Serverless API for start-replication and describe-replications
- `aws-sdk-rdsdata` (1.61.0): Add support for Stop DB feature.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.76.0): Added support for Content-Range header in HeadObject response.
- `aws-sdk-wafv2` (1.65.0): The WAFv2 API now supports configuring data protection in webACLs.
- `aws-sdk-workspacesthinclient` (1.61.0): Update Environment and Device name field definitions

February 13th, 2025
===================
**New this release:**
- :bug: ([aws-sdk-rust#1244](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1244)) Fix bug in Sigv4 signing that, when an endpoint contained a default port (80 for HTTP, 443 for HTTPS), would sign the request with that port in the `HOST` header even though Hyper excludes default ports from the `HOST` header.
- :bug: ([aws-sdk-rust#1253](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1253)) Fix bug in S3 with flexible checksum headers incorrectly included in presigned GET requests.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-accessanalyzer` (1.64.0): This release introduces the getFindingsStatistics API, enabling users to retrieve aggregated finding statistics for IAM Access Analyzer's external access and unused access analysis features. Updated service API and documentation.
- `aws-sdk-fis` (1.62.0): Adds auto-pagination for the following operations: ListActions, ListExperimentTemplates, ListTargetAccountConfigurations, ListExperiments, ListExperimentResolvedTargets, ListTargetResourceTypes. Reduces length constraints of prefixes for logConfiguration and experimentReportConfiguration.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.103.0): Adds additional values to the InferenceAmiVersion parameter in the ProductionVariant data type.
- `aws-sdk-storagegateway` (1.63.0): This release adds support for generating cache reports on S3 File Gateways for files that fail to upload.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-acmpca` (1.63.0): Private Certificate Authority (PCA) documentation updates
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.67.0): This is a documentation only release to support migrating Amazon ECS service ARNs to the long ARN format.

February 12th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-b2bi` (1.63.0): Allow spaces in the following fields in the Partnership resource: ISA 06 - Sender ID, ISA 08 - Receiver ID, GS 02 - Application Sender Code, GS 03 - Application Receiver Code
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.78.0): This releases adds the additionalModelRequestFields field to the CreateAgent and UpdateAgent operations. Use additionalModelRequestFields to specify  additional inference parameters for a model beyond the base inference parameters.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.78.0): This releases adds the additionalModelRequestFields field to the InvokeInlineAgent operation. Use additionalModelRequestFields to specify  additional inference parameters for a model beyond the base inference parameters.
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.65.0): Support for in-place Lustre version upgrades
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.73.0): Adds a RequestId parameter to all MediaLive Workflow Monitor create operations.  The RequestId parameter allows idempotent operations.
- `aws-sdk-opensearchserverless` (1.62.0): Custom OpenSearchServerless Entity ID for SAML Config.
- `aws-sdk-polly` (1.61.0): Added support for the new voice - Jasmine (en-SG). Jasmine is available as a Neural voice only.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.73.1): Add note for the RUNNER_BUILDKITE_BUILD buildType.

February 11th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-acmpca` (1.62.0): Private Certificate Authority service now supports Partitioned CRL as a revocation configuration option.
- `aws-sdk-appsync` (1.69.0): Add support for operation level caching
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.109.0): Adding support for the new fullSnapshotSizeInBytes field in the response of the EC2 EBS DescribeSnapshots API. This field represents the size of all the blocks that were written to the source volume at the time the snapshot was created.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-pi` (1.60.1): Documentation only update for RDS Performance Insights dimensions for execution plans and locking analysis.

February 10th, 2025
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-apigatewayv2` (1.59.0): Documentation updates for Amazon API Gateway
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.62.0): New vendors for DMS Data Providers: DB2 LUW and DB2 for z/OS

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.64.1): Doc-only update that adds defaults for CloudFront VpcOriginEndpointConfig values.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.90.1): Updated the CreateContact API documentation to indicate that it only applies to EMAIL contacts.

February 7th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.64.0): Adds support to handle the new basic scanning daily quota.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.73.0): Introduce versionStatus field to take place of status field in EKS DescribeClusterVersions API
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.71.0): This release adds support for Animated GIF output, forced chroma sample positioning metadata, and Extensible Wave Container format
- `aws-sdk-pi` (1.60.0): Adds documentation for dimension groups and dimensions to analyze locks for Database Insights.
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.61.0): This release adds support for the Clinical Note Template Customization feature for the AWS HealthScribe APIs within Amazon Transcribe.
- `aws-sdk-transcribestreaming` (1.60.0): This release adds support for the Clinical Note Template Customization feature for the AWS HealthScribe Streaming APIs within Amazon Transcribe.

February 6th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudformation` (1.65.0): We added 5 new stack refactoring APIs: CreateStackRefactor, ExecuteStackRefactor, ListStackRefactors, DescribeStackRefactor, ListStackRefactorActions.
- `aws-sdk-connectcases` (1.62.0): This release adds the ability to conditionally require fields on a template. Check public documentation for more information.
- `aws-sdk-costoptimizationhub` (1.60.0): This release enables AWS Cost Optimization Hub to show cost optimization recommendations for Amazon Auto Scaling Groups, including those with single and mixed instance types.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.74.0): Updated list of the valid AWS Region values for the LocationConstraint parameter for general purpose buckets.

February 4th, 2025
==================
**New this release:**
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#3992](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/3992)) Stop populating `SessionMode` by default for the `CreateSession` API internally used by S3 Express. This will allow the service to choose a default value for `SessionMode` field based on bucket/access point being used.
- :bug: ([smithy-rs#3991](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/3991)) Exclude `transfer-encoding` header from sigv4(a) signing since it is a hop by hop header that can be modified or removed by a proxy.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.61.0): Introduces TargetDataSettings with the TablePreparationMode option available for data migrations.
- `aws-sdk-iam` (1.61.0): This release adds support for accepting encrypted SAML assertions. Customers can now configure their identity provider to encrypt the SAML assertions it sends to IAM.
- `aws-sdk-neptunegraph` (1.57.0): Added argument to `list-export` to filter by graph ID
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.66.0): Adds functionality to enable/disable a new Q Business Chat orchestration feature. If enabled, Q Business can orchestrate over datasources and plugins without the need for customers to select specific chat modes.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.64.0): Doc-only update to provide more information on using Kerberos authentication with SMB locations.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.102.0): IPv6 support for Hyperpod clusters

January 31st, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amp` (1.58.0): Add support for sending metrics to cross account and CMCK AMP workspaces through RoleConfiguration on Create/Update Scraper.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.76.0): This change is to deprecate the existing citation field under RetrieveAndGenerateStream API response in lieu of GeneratedResponsePart and RetrievedReferences
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.72.0): Added support for CodeBuild self-hosted Buildkite runner builds
- `aws-sdk-georoutes` (1.11.0): The OptimizeWaypoints API now supports 50 waypoints per request (20 with constraints like AccessHours or AppointmentTime). It adds waypoint clustering via Clustering and ClusteringIndex for better optimization. Also, total distance validation is removed for greater flexibility.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.101.0): This release introduces a new valid value in InstanceType parameter: p5en.48xlarge, in ProductionVariant.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.76.1): Updates to Aurora MySQL and Aurora PostgreSQL API pages with instance log type in the create and modify DB Cluster.

January 30th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.62.0): Add support for managing admin consent requirement on selected domains for OneDrive Storage Connectors in AppStream2.0.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.75.0): Add a 'reason' field to InternalServerException
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.62.0): Temporarily updating dualstack endpoint support
- `aws-sdk-ecrpublic` (1.59.0): Temporarily updating dualstack endpoint support
- `aws-sdk-mediatailor` (1.60.0): Adds options for configuring how MediaTailor conditions ads before inserting them into the content stream. Based on the new settings, MediaTailor will either transcode ads to match the content stream as it has in the past, or it will insert ads without first transcoding them.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.65.0): Added APIs to manage QBusiness user subscriptions
- `aws-sdk-s3tables` (1.8.0): You can now use the CreateTable API operation to create tables with schemas by adding an optional metadata argument.
- `aws-sdk-verifiedpermissions` (1.64.0): Adds Cedar JSON format support for entities and context data in authorization requests

January 29th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bcmpricingcalculator` (1.10.0): Added ConflictException error type in DeleteBillScenario, BatchDeleteBillScenarioCommitmentModification, BatchDeleteBillScenarioUsageModification, BatchUpdateBillScenarioUsageModification, and BatchUpdateBillScenarioCommitmentModification API operations.
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.61.0): Add support for Dualstack and Dualstack-with-FIPS Endpoints
- `aws-sdk-ecrpublic` (1.58.0): Add support for Dualstack Endpoints
- `aws-sdk-mailmanager` (1.35.0): This release includes a new feature for Amazon SES Mail Manager which allows customers to specify known addresses and domains and make use of those in traffic policies and rules actions to distinguish between known and unknown entries.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.72.0): Change the type of MpuObjectSize in CompleteMultipartUploadRequest from int to long.
- `aws-sdk-transcribestreaming` (1.58.0): This release adds support for AWS HealthScribe Streaming APIs within Amazon Transcribe.

January 28th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appsync` (1.66.0): Add stash and outErrors to EvaluateCode/EvaluateMappingTemplate response
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.62.0): AWS DataSync now supports the Kerberos authentication protocol for SMB locations.
- `aws-sdk-deadline` (1.42.0): feature: Deadline: Add support for limiting the concurrent usage of external resources, like floating licenses, using limits and the ability to constrain the maximum number of workers that work on a job
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.106.0): This release changes the CreateFleet CLI and SDK's such that if you do not specify a client token, a randomly generated token is used for the request to ensure idempotency.
- `aws-sdk-firehose` (1.63.0): For AppendOnly streams, Firehose will automatically scale to match your throughput.
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.42.0): Adds 'allocatedStorage' parameter to UpdateDbInstance API that allows increasing the database instance storage size and 'dbStorageType' parameter to UpdateDbInstance API that allows changing the storage type of the database instance

January 27th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.75.0): Add support for the prompt caching feature for Bedrock Prompt Management
- `aws-sdk-iot` (1.65.0): Raised the documentParameters size limit to 30 KB for AWS IoT Device Management - Jobs.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.68.0): This release adds support for dynamic audio configuration and the ability to disable the deblocking filter for h265 encodes.
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.62.0): Minor fix to ARN validation for Lambda functions passed to S3 Batch Operations

January 24th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudtrail` (1.62.0): This release introduces the SearchSampleQueries API that allows users to search for CloudTrail Lake sample queries.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.70.0): Adds support for UpdateStrategies in EKS Managed Node Groups.
- `aws-sdk-healthlake` (1.58.0): Added new authorization strategy value 'SMART_ON_FHIR' for CreateFHIRDatastore API to support Smart App 2.0
- `aws-sdk-transfer` (1.64.0): Added CustomDirectories as a new directory option for storing inbound AS2 messages, MDN files and Status files.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ssm` (1.62.1): Systems Manager doc-only update for January, 2025.
- `aws-sdk-ssooidc` (1.57.1): Fixed typos in the descriptions.

January 23rd, 2025
==================
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([aws-sdk-rust#1233](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1233)) Allow IMDS clients to be configured with a user-provided `SharedRetryClassifier`.
- :bug: ([aws-sdk-rust#1248](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1248)) Fix `EcsCredentialsProvider` to include query params passed via `AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI`.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.105.0): Added "future" allocation type for future dated capacity reservation

January 22nd, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.72.0): Adds multi-turn input support for an Agent node in an Amazon Bedrock Flow
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.69.0): AWS Elemental MediaLive adds a new feature, ID3 segment tagging, in CMAF Ingest output groups. It allows customers to insert ID3 tags into every output segment, controlled by a newly added channel schedule action Id3SegmentTagging.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.78.1): Docs Update for timeout changes
- `aws-sdk-workspacesthinclient` (1.56.1): Rename WorkSpaces Web to WorkSpaces Secure Browser

January 21st, 2025
==================
**New this release:**
- :bug: ([aws-sdk-rust#1240](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1240)) Fix bug with presigned requests introduced by new flexibile checksums functionality

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.65.0): corrects the dual-stack endpoint configuration for cognitoidp
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.87.0): Added DeleteContactFlowVersion API and the CAMPAIGN flow type
- `aws-sdk-emrserverless` (1.60.0): Increasing entryPoint in SparkSubmit to accept longer script paths. New limit is 4kb.
- `aws-sdk-iotsitewise` (1.58.0): AWS IoT SiteWise now supports ingestion and querying of Null (all data types) and NaN (double type) values of bad or uncertain data quality. New partial error handling prevents data loss during ingestion. Enabled by default for new customers; existing customers can opt-in.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.72.0): Added `DigitGroupingStyle` in ThousandsSeparator to allow grouping by `LAKH`( Indian Grouping system ) currency. Support LAKH and `CRORE` currency types in Column Formatting.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.64.0): Documentation-only update: clarified the description of the shareDecaySeconds parameter of the FairsharePolicy data type, clarified the description of the priority parameter of the JobQueueDetail data type.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.66.0): Documentation-only update to address doc errors
- `aws-sdk-sns` (1.56.0): This release adds support for the topic attribute FifoThroughputScope for SNS FIFO topics. For details, see the documentation history in the Amazon Simple Notification Service Developer Guide.

January 17th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.69.0): Allow hyphens in tool name for Converse and ConverseStream APIs
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.103.0): Release u7i-6tb.112xlarge, u7i-8tb.112xlarge, u7inh-32tb.480xlarge, p5e.48xlarge, p5en.48xlarge, f2.12xlarge, f2.48xlarge, trn2.48xlarge instance types.
- `aws-sdk-notifications` (1.6.0): Added support for Managed Notifications, integration with AWS Organization and added aggregation summaries for Aggregate Notifications

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-detective` (1.54.1): Doc only update for Detective documentation.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.97.1): Correction of docs for  "Added support for ml.trn1.32xlarge instance type in Reserved Capacity Offering"

January 15th, 2025
==================
**New this release:**
- :bug::tada: ([smithy-rs#3845](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/3845)) S3 client behavior is updated to always calculate a checksum by default for operations that support it (such as PutObject or UploadPart), or require it (such as DeleteObjects). The default checksum algorithm is CRC32. Checksum behavior can be configured using `when_supported` and `when_required` options - in shared config using request_checksum_calculation, or as env variable using AWS_REQUEST_CHECKSUM_CALCULATION.

    The S3 client attempts to validate response checksums for all S3 API operations that support checksums. However, if the SDK has not implemented the specified checksum algorithm then this validation is skipped. Checksum validation behavior can be configured using `when_supported` and `when_required` options - in shared config using response_checksum_validation, or as env variable using AWS_RESPONSE_CHECKSUM_VALIDATION.
- :bug: ([aws-sdk-rust#1234](https://github.com/awslabs/aws-sdk-rust/issues/1234)) Fix token bucket not being set for standard and adaptive retry modes

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.70.0): Now supports streaming for inline agents.
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentity` (1.55.0): corrects the dual-stack endpoint configuration
- `aws-sdk-partnercentralselling` (1.7.0): Add Tagging support for ResourceSnapshotJob resources
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.69.0): This change enhances integrity protections for new SDK requests to S3. S3 SDKs now support the CRC64NVME checksum algorithm, full object checksums for multipart S3 objects, and new default integrity protections for S3 requests.
- `aws-sdk-securityir` (1.5.0): Increase minimum length of Threat Actor IP 'userAgent' to 1.
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.61.0): This release introduces a new recommendation in Virtual Deliverability Manager Advisor, which detects elevated complaint rates for customer sending identities.
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.65.0): Added GeneralPurpose.4xlarge & GeneralPurpose.8xlarge ComputeTypes.
- `aws-sdk-workspacesthinclient` (1.55.0): Mark type in MaintenanceWindow as required.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-apigateway` (1.56.0): Documentation updates for Amazon API Gateway

January 14th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-gamelift` (1.59.0): Amazon GameLift releases a new game session placement feature: PriorityConfigurationOverride. You can now override how a game session queue prioritizes placement locations for a single StartGameSessionPlacement request.
- `aws-sdk-route53` (1.59.0): Amazon Route 53 now supports the Mexico (Central) Region (mx-central-1) for latency records, geoproximity records, and private DNS for Amazon VPCs in that region

January 13th, 2025
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-artifact` (1.43.0): Support resolving regional API calls to partition's leader region endpoint.
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.68.0): With this release, Bedrock Evaluation will now support latency-optimized inference for foundation models.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.101.0): Add support for DisconnectOnSessionTimeout flag in CreateClientVpnEndpoint and ModifyClientVpnEndpoint requests and DescribeClientVpnEndpoints responses
- `aws-sdk-kafkaconnect` (1.55.0): Support updating connector configuration via UpdateConnector API. Release Operations API to monitor the status of the connector operation.
- `aws-sdk-transcribe` (1.55.0): This update provides tagging support for Transcribe's Call Analytics Jobs and Call Analytics Categories.

- `aws-sdk-redshift` (1.58.1): Additions to the PubliclyAccessible and Encrypted parameters clarifying what the defaults are.
- `aws-sdk-securitylake` (1.56.1): Doc only update for ServiceName that fixes several customer-reported issues
- `aws-sdk-sts` (1.54.1): Fixed typos in the descriptions.

January 9th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-codebuild` (1.67.0): AWS CodeBuild Now Supports BuildBatch in Reserved Capacity and Lambda
- `aws-sdk-computeoptimizer` (1.56.0): This release expands AWS Compute Optimizer rightsizing recommendation support for Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups to include those with scaling policies and multiple instance types.
- `aws-sdk-fms` (1.58.0): AWS Firewall Manager now lets you combine multiple resource tags using the logical AND operator or the logical OR operator.

January 8th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-route53` (1.58.0): Amazon Route 53 now supports the Asia Pacific (Thailand) Region (ap-southeast-7) for latency records, geoproximity records, and private DNS for Amazon VPCs in that region
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.95.0): Adds support for IPv6 for SageMaker HyperPod cluster nodes.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.72.1): Updates Amazon RDS documentation to clarify the RestoreDBClusterToPointInTime description.

January 7th, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudhsmv2` (1.56.0): Adds support to ModifyCluster for modifying a Cluster's Hsm Type.
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.59.0): This release makes Amazon DynamoDB point-in-time-recovery (PITR) to be configurable. You can set PITR recovery period for each table individually to between 1 and 35 days.
- `aws-sdk-imagebuilder` (1.57.0): This release adds support for importing images from ISO disk files. Added new ImportDiskImage API operation.

January 2nd, 2025
=================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appsync` (1.61.0): Modify UpdateGraphQLAPI operation and flag authenticationType as required.
- `aws-sdk-gamelift` (1.57.0): Amazon GameLift releases a new game session shutdown feature. Use the Amazon GameLift console or AWS CLI to terminate an in-progress game session that's entered a bad state or is no longer needed.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconnect` (1.56.0): AWS Elemental MediaConnect now supports Content Quality Analysis for enhanced source stream monitoring. This enables you to track specific audio and video metrics in transport stream source flows, ensuring your content meets quality standards.
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.63.0): This release adds support for the AVC3 codec and fixes an alignment issue with Japanese vertical captions.
- `aws-sdk-organizations` (1.60.0): Added ALL_FEATURES_MIGRATION_ORGANIZATION_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED to ConstraintViolationException for the EnableAllFeatures operation.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.93.0): Adding ETag information with Model Artifacts for Model Registry

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-sqs` (1.52.1): In-flight message typo fix from 20k to 120k.

December 23rd, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-ecrpublic` (1.52.0): Add support for Dualstack endpoints
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.64.0): This release adds support for DescribeClusterVersions API that provides important information about Kubernetes versions along with end of support dates
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.74.0): Add IncludeRoot parameters to GetCatalogs API to return root catalog.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ecr` (1.54.1): Documentation update for ECR GetAccountSetting and PutAccountSetting APIs.

December 20th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.69.0): Support for custom user agent and max web pages crawled for web connector. Support app only credentials for SharePoint connector. Increase agents memory duration limit to 365 days. Support to specify max number of session summaries to include in agent invocation context.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.67.0): bedrock agents now supports long term memory and performance configs. Invokeflow supports performance configs. RetrieveAndGenerate performance configs
- `aws-sdk-billing` (1.3.0): Added new API's for defining and fetching Billing Views.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.83.0): This release supports adding NotAttributeCondition and Range to the RoutingCriteria object.
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.57.0): Support for retrieving cost, usage, and forecast for billing view.
- `aws-sdk-docdb` (1.55.0): Support AWS Secret Manager managed password for AWS DocumentDB instance-based cluster.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.63.0): This release expands the catalog of upgrade insight checks
- `aws-sdk-macie2` (1.54.0): This release adds support for identifying S3 general purpose buckets that exceed the Amazon Macie quota for preventative control monitoring.
- `aws-sdk-outposts` (1.57.0): Add CS8365C as a supported power connector for Outpost sites.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.91.0): This release adds support for c6i, m6i and r6i instance on SageMaker Hyperpod and trn1 instances in batch

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomation` (1.1.1): Documentation update for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomationruntime` (1.1.1): Documentation update for Amazon Bedrock Data Automation Runtime

December 19th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-appstream` (1.55.0): Added support for Rocky Linux 8 on Amazon AppStream 2.0
- `aws-sdk-mediaconvert` (1.61.0): This release adds support for inserting timecode tracks into MP4 container outputs.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.64.0): MediaLive is releasing ListVersions api
- `aws-sdk-qconnect` (1.58.0): Amazon Q in Connect enables agents to ask Q for assistance in multiple languages and Q will provide answers and recommended step-by-step guides in those languages. Qs default language is English (United States) and you can switch this by setting the locale configuration on the AI Agent.
- `aws-sdk-ssmsap` (1.54.0): AWS Systems Manager for SAP added support for registration and discovery of distributed ABAP applications
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.62.0): Added AWS Global Accelerator (AGA) support for WorkSpaces Personal.

December 18th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-amplify` (1.56.0): Added WAF Configuration to Amplify Apps
- `aws-sdk-budgets` (1.53.0): Releasing minor partition endpoint updates
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.82.0): This release adds support for the UpdateParticipantAuthentication API used for customer authentication within Amazon Connect chats.
- `aws-sdk-connectparticipant` (1.53.0): This release adds support for the GetAuthenticationUrl and CancelParticipantAuthentication APIs used for customer authentication within Amazon Connect chats. There are also minor updates to the GetAttachment API.
- `aws-sdk-datasync` (1.56.0): AWS DataSync introduces the ability to update attributes for in-cloud locations.
- `aws-sdk-iot` (1.59.0): Release connectivity status query API which is a dedicated high throughput(TPS) API to query a specific device's most recent connectivity state and metadata.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.68.0): Add support for PerformanceConfiguration attribute to Dataset entity. Allow PerformanceConfiguration specification in CreateDataset and UpdateDataset APIs.
- `aws-sdk-resiliencehub` (1.55.0): AWS Resilience Hub now automatically detects already configured CloudWatch alarms and FIS experiments as part of the assessment process and returns the discovered resources in the corresponding list API responses. It also allows you to include or exclude test recommendations for an AppComponent.
- `aws-sdk-transfer` (1.58.0): Added AS2 agreement configurations to control filename preservation and message signing enforcement. Added AS2 connector configuration to preserve content type from S3 objects.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-mwaa` (1.56.1): Added support for Apache Airflow version 2.10.3 to MWAA.

December 18th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-account` (1.53.0): Update endpoint configuration.
- `aws-sdk-backup` (1.55.0): Add Support for Backup Indexing
- `aws-sdk-backupsearch` (1.0.0): Add support for searching backups
- `aws-sdk-batch` (1.60.0): This feature allows AWS Batch on Amazon EKS to support configuration of Pod Annotations, overriding Namespace on which the Batch job's Pod runs on, and allows Subpath and Persistent Volume claim to be set for AWS Batch on Amazon EKS jobs.
- `aws-sdk-cleanroomsml` (1.52.0): Add support for SQL compute configuration for StartAudienceGenerationJob API.
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.57.0): Adds support for OriginReadTimeout and OriginKeepaliveTimeout to create CloudFront Distributions with VPC Origins.
- `aws-sdk-codepipeline` (1.60.0): AWS CodePipeline V2 type pipelines now support Managed Compute Rule.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.59.0): Added support for enableFaultInjection task definition parameter which can be used to enable Fault Injection feature on ECS tasks.
- `aws-sdk-m2` (1.54.0): This release adds support for AWS Mainframe Modernization(M2) Service to allow specifying network type(ipv4, dual) for the environment instances. For dual network type, m2 environment applications will serve both IPv4 and IPv6 requests, whereas for ipv4 it will serve only IPv4 requests.
- `aws-sdk-synthetics` (1.54.0): Add support to toggle outbound IPv6 traffic on canaries connected to dualstack subnets.  This behavior can be controlled via the new Ipv6AllowedForDualStack parameter of the VpcConfig input object in CreateCanary and UpdateCanary APIs.

December 18th, 2024
===================
**New this release:**
- :tada: ([smithy-rs#3583](https://github.com/smithy-lang/smithy-rs/issues/3583)) It is now possible to disable payload signing through an operation customization.

    ```rust
    async fn put_example_object(client: &aws_sdk_s3::Client) {
        let res = client
            .put_object()
            .bucket("test-bucket")
            .key("test-key")
            .body(ByteStream::from_static(b"Hello, world!"))
            .customize()
            // Setting this will disable payload signing.
            .disable_payload_signing()
            .send()
            .await;
    }
    ```

    Disabling payload signing will result in a small speedup at the cost of removing a data integrity check.
    However, this is an advanced feature and **may not be supported by all services/operations**.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-dlm` (1.51.0): This release adds support for Local Zones in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager EBS snapshot lifecycle policies.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.98.0): This release adds support for EBS local snapshots in AWS Dedicated Local Zones, which allows you to store snapshots of EBS volumes locally in Dedicated Local Zones.
- `aws-sdk-greengrassv2` (1.52.0): Add support for runtime in GetCoreDevice and ListCoreDevices APIs.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.63.0): AWS Elemental MediaLive adds three new features: MediaPackage v2 endpoint support for live stream delivery, KLV metadata passthrough in CMAF Ingest output groups, and Metadata Name Modifier in CMAF Ingest output groups for customizing metadata track names in output streams.
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.70.0): This release adds support for the "MYSQL_CACHING_SHA2_PASSWORD" enum value for RDS Proxy ClientPasswordAuthType.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloud9` (1.52.0): Added information about Ubuntu 18.04 will be removed from the available imageIds for Cloud9 because Ubuntu 18.04 has ended standard support on May 31, 2023.

December 13th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudhsmv2` (1.52.0): Add support for Dual-Stack hsm2m.medium clusters. The customers will now be able to create hsm2m.medium clusters having both IPv4 and IPv6 connection capabilities by specifying a new param called NetworkType=DUALSTACK during cluster creation.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.61.0): Limit PutIntegration IntegrationName and ListIntegrations IntegrationNamePrefix parameters to 50 characters
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.97.0): This release adds GroupId to the response for DeleteSecurityGroup.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.61.0): Add NodeRepairConfig in CreateNodegroupRequest and UpdateNodegroupConfigRequest
- `aws-sdk-mediaconnect` (1.53.0): AWS Elemental MediaConnect Gateway now supports Source Specific Multicast (SSM) for ingress bridges. This enables you to specify a source IP address in addition to a multicast IP when creating or updating an ingress bridge source.
- `aws-sdk-servicediscovery` (1.51.0): AWS Cloud Map now supports service-level attributes, allowing you to associate custom metadata directly with services. These attributes can be retrieved, updated, and deleted using the new GetServiceAttributes, UpdateServiceAttributes, and DeleteServiceAttributes API calls.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-networkmanager` (1.53.1): There was a sentence fragment in UpdateDirectConnectGatewayAttachment that was causing customer confusion as to whether it's an incomplete sentence or if it was a typo. Removed the fragment.

December 12th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.80.0): Configure holidays and other overrides to hours of operation in advance. During contact handling, Amazon Connect automatically checks for overrides and provides customers with an appropriate flow path. After an override period passes call center automatically reverts to standard hours of operation.
- `aws-sdk-databasemigration` (1.53.0): Add parameters to support for kerberos authentication. Add parameter for disabling the Unicode source filter with PostgreSQL settings. Add parameter to use large integer value with Kinesis/Kafka settings.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.72.0): To support customer-managed encryption in Data Quality to allow customers encrypt data with their own KMS key, we will add a DataQualityEncryption field to the SecurityConfiguration API where customers can provide their KMS keys.
- `aws-sdk-route53domains` (1.53.0): This release includes the following API updates: added the enumeration type RESTORE_DOMAIN to the OperationType; constrained the Price attribute to non-negative values; updated the LangCode to allow 2 or 3 alphabetical characters.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.59.1): Improved descriptions for certain APIs.

December 11th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-artifact` (1.39.0): Add support for listing active customer agreements for the calling AWS Account.
- `aws-sdk-emrserverless` (1.55.0): This release adds support for accessing system profile logs in Lake Formation-enabled jobs.
- `aws-sdk-migrationhub` (1.51.0): API and documentation updates for AWS MigrationHub related to adding support for listing migration task updates and associating, disassociating and listing source resources
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.57.0): Introduces support for multi-region endpoint.
- `aws-sdk-timestreaminfluxdb` (1.35.0): Adds networkType parameter to CreateDbInstance API which allows IPv6 support to the InfluxDB endpoint

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudtrail` (1.55.1): Doc-only updates for CloudTrail.
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.60.1): Updated descriptions for some API operations and parameters, corrected some errors in Cognito user pools
- `aws-sdk-controlcatalog` (1.33.1): Minor documentation updates to the content of ImplementationDetails object part of the Control Catalog GetControl API

December 10th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bcmpricingcalculator` (1.2.0): Updated condition key inference from Workload Estimate, Bill Scenario, and Bill Estimate resources. Updated documentation links.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.79.0): Add support for Push Notifications for Amazon Connect chat. With Push Notifications enabled an alert could be sent to customers about new messages even when they aren't actively using the mobile application.
- `aws-sdk-finspace` (1.54.0): Update KxCommandLineArgument value parameter regex to allow for spaces and semicolons
- `aws-sdk-ivsrealtime` (1.56.0): IVS Real-Time now offers customers the ability to customize thumbnails recording mode and interval for both Individual Participant Recording (IPR) and Server-Side Compositions (SSC).
- `aws-sdk-sesv2` (1.56.0): Introduces support for creating DEED (Deterministic Easy-DKIM) identities.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-applicationautoscaling` (1.55.1): Doc only update for AAS Predictive Scaling policy configuration API.
- `aws-sdk-dsql` (1.0.1): Doc only update to examples for DeleteMultiRegionClusters & CreateMultiRegionClusters

December 9th, 2024
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.60.0): Change `CustomDomainConfig` from a required to an optional parameter for the `UpdateUserPoolDomain` operation.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.96.0): This release includes a new API for modifying instance network-performance-options after launch.
- `aws-sdk-medialive` (1.62.0): H265 outputs now support disabling the deblocking filter.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-appsync` (1.58.1): Provides description of new Amazon Bedrock runtime datasource.
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.57.1): This is a documentation only update to address various tickets for Amazon ECS.
- `aws-sdk-keyspaces` (1.53.1): Amazon Keyspaces: adding the list of IAM actions required by the UpdateKeyspace API.
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.60.1): Added text to clarify case-sensitivity

December 5th, 2024
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-partnercentralselling` (1.3.0): Introducing the preview of new partner central selling APIs designed to transform how AWS partners collaborate and co-sell with multiple partners. This enables multiple partners to seamlessly engage and jointly pursue customer opportunities, fostering a new era of collaborative selling.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.57.0): This release removes the deprecated UserId and UserGroups fields from SearchRelevantContent api's request parameters.

December 4th, 2024
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.64.0): Introduced two APIs ListPromptRouters and GetPromptRouter for Intelligent Prompt Router feature. Add support for Bedrock Guardrails image content filter. New Bedrock Marketplace feature enabling a wider range of bedrock compatible models with self-hosted capability.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.67.0): This release introduces the ability to generate SQL using natural language, through a new GenerateQuery API (with native integration into Knowledge Bases); ability to ingest and retrieve images through Bedrock Data Automation; and ability to create a Knowledge Base backed by Kendra GenAI Index.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.65.0): This release introduces the ability to generate SQL using natural language, through a new GenerateQuery API (with native integration into Knowledge Bases); ability to ingest and retrieve images through Bedrock Data Automation; and ability to create a Knowledge Base backed by Kendra GenAI Index.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomation` (1.0.0): Release Bedrock Data Automation SDK
- `aws-sdk-bedrockdataautomationruntime` (1.0.0): Release Bedrock Data Automation Runtime SDK
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.64.0): Added support for Intelligent Prompt Router in Invoke, InvokeStream, Converse and ConverseStream. Add support for Bedrock Guardrails image content filter. New Bedrock Marketplace feature enabling a wider range of bedrock compatible models with self-hosted capability.
- `aws-sdk-kendra` (1.52.0): This release adds GenAI Index in Amazon Kendra for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and intelligent search. With the Kendra GenAI Index, customers get high retrieval accuracy powered by the latest information retrieval technologies and semantic models.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.89.0): Amazon SageMaker HyperPod launched task governance to help customers maximize accelerator utilization for model development and flexible training plans to meet training timelines and budget while reducing weeks of training time. AI apps from AWS partner is now available in SageMaker.

December 4th, 2024
==================
**New this release:**
- :tada: Add auth token generator for Amazon Aurora DSQL.

    ```rust
    use aws_sdk_dsql::auth_token::{AuthTokenGenerator, Config};

    #[tokio::main]
    async fn main() {
       let cfg = aws_config::load_defaults(BehaviorVersion::latest()).await;
       let generator = AuthTokenGenerator::new(
           Config::builder()
               .hostname("peccy.dsql.us-east-1.on.aws")
               .build()
               .expect("cfg is valid"),
       );
       let token = generator.auth_token(&cfg).await.unwrap();
       println!("{token}");
    }
    ```

    The resulting token can then be used as a password when connecting to the
    database server.

**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-athena` (1.54.0): Add FEDERATED type to CreateDataCatalog. This creates Athena Data Catalog, AWS Lambda connector, and AWS Glue connection. Create/DeleteDataCatalog returns DataCatalog. Add Status, ConnectionType, and Error to DataCatalog and DataCatalogSummary. Add DeleteCatalogOnly to delete Athena Catalog only.
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.63.0): Tagging support for Async Invoke resources. Added support for Distillation in CreateModelCustomizationJob API. Support for videoDataDeliveryEnabled flag in invocation logging.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.66.0): Releasing SDK for Multi-Agent Collaboration.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.64.0): Releasing SDK for multi agent collaboration
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.63.0): Added support for Async Invoke Operations Start, List and Get. Support for invocation logs with `requestMetadata` field in Converse, ConverseStream, Invoke and InvokeStream. Video content blocks in Converse/ConverseStream accept raw bytes or S3 URI.
- `aws-sdk-datazone` (1.63.0): Adds support for Connections, ProjectProfiles, and JobRuns APIs. Supports the new Lineage feature at GA. Adjusts optionality of a parameter for DataSource and SubscriptionTarget APIs which may adjust types in some clients.
- `aws-sdk-dsql` (1.0.0): Add new API operations for Amazon Aurora DSQL. Amazon Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with virtually unlimited scale, highest availability, and zero infrastructure management.
- `aws-sdk-dynamodb` (1.55.0): This change adds support for global tables with multi-Region strong consistency (in preview). The UpdateTable API now supports a new attribute MultiRegionConsistency to set consistency when creating global tables. The DescribeTable output now optionally includes the MultiRegionConsistency attribute.
- `aws-sdk-glue` (1.71.0): This release includes(1)Zero-ETL integration to ingest data from 3P SaaS and DynamoDB to Redshift/Redlake (2)new properties on Connections to enable reuse; new connection APIs for retrieve/preview metadata (3)support of CRUD operations for Multi-catalog (4)support of automatic statistics collections
- `aws-sdk-lakeformation` (1.53.0): This release added two new LakeFormation Permissions (CREATE_CATALOG, SUPER_USER) and added Id field for CatalogResource. It also added new conditon and expression field.
- `aws-sdk-qapps` (1.18.0): Add support for 11 new plugins as action cards to help automate repetitive tasks and improve productivity.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.56.0): Amazon Q Business now supports customization options for your web experience, 11 new Plugins, and QuickSight support. Amazon Q index allows software providers to enrich their native generative AI experiences with their customer's enterprise knowledge and user context spanning multiple applications.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.66.0): This release includes API needed to support for Unstructured Data in Q in QuickSight Q&A (IDC).
- `aws-sdk-redshift` (1.55.0): Adds support for Amazon Redshift RegisterNamespace and DeregisterNamespace APIs to share data to AWS Glue Data Catalog.
- `aws-sdk-redshiftserverless` (1.53.0): Adds support for the ListManagedWorkgroups API to get an overview of existing managed workgroups.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.65.0): Amazon S3 Metadata stores object metadata in read-only, fully managed Apache Iceberg metadata tables that you can query. You can create metadata table configurations for S3 general purpose buckets.
- `aws-sdk-s3tables` (1.0.0): Amazon S3 Tables deliver the first cloud object store with built-in open table format support, and the easiest way to store tabular data at scale.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatch` (1.56.0): Support for configuring AiOps investigation as alarm action

December 3rd, 2024
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` (1.62.0): Add an API parameter that allows customers to set performance configuration for invoking a model.
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.54.0): It allows customers to pass CRC64NVME as a header in S3 Batch Operations copy requests
- `aws-sdk-socialmessaging` (1.4.0): Added support for passing role arn corresponding to the supported event destination

December 2nd, 2024
==================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrock` (1.62.0): Add support for Knowledge Base Evaluations & LLM as a judge
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.65.0): This release introduces APIs to upload documents directly into a Knowledge Base
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.63.0): This release introduces a new Rerank API to leverage reranking models (with integration into Knowledge Bases); APIs to upload documents directly into Knowledge Base; RetrieveAndGenerateStream API for streaming response; Guardrails on Retrieve API; and ability to automatically generate filters
- `aws-sdk-chimesdkvoice` (1.51.0): This release adds supports for enterprises to integrate Amazon Connect with other voice systems. It supports directly transferring voice calls and metadata without using the public telephone network. It also supports real-time and post-call analytics.
- `aws-sdk-cleanrooms` (1.57.0): This release allows customers and their partners to easily collaborate with data stored in Snowflake and Amazon Athena, without having to move or share their underlying data among collaborators.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.59.0): Adds PutIntegration, GetIntegration, ListIntegrations and DeleteIntegration APIs. Adds QueryLanguage support to StartQuery, GetQueryResults, DescribeQueries, DescribeQueryDefinitions, and PutQueryDefinition APIs.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.77.0): Adds support for WhatsApp Business messaging, IVR call recording, enabling Contact Lens for existing on-premise contact centers and telephony platforms, and enabling telephony and IVR migration to Amazon Connect independent of their contact center agents.
- `aws-sdk-connectcampaignsv2` (1.1.0): Amazon Connect Outbound Campaigns V2 / Features : Adds support for Event-Triggered Campaigns.
- `aws-sdk-customerprofiles` (1.54.0): This release introduces Event Trigger APIs as part of Amazon Connect Customer Profiles service.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.94.0): Adds support for declarative policies that allow you to enforce desired configuration across an AWS organization through configuring account attributes. Adds support for Allowed AMIs that allows you to limit the use of AMIs in AWS accounts. Adds support for connectivity over non-HTTP protocols.
- `aws-sdk-eks` (1.59.0): Added support for Auto Mode Clusters, Hybrid Nodes, and specifying computeTypes in the DescribeAddonVersions API.
- `aws-sdk-eventbridge` (1.52.0): Call private APIs by configuring Connections with VPC connectivity through PrivateLink and VPC Lattice
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.55.0): FSx API changes to support the public launch of the Amazon FSx Intelligent Tiering for OpenZFS storage class.
- `aws-sdk-guardduty` (1.58.0): Add new Multi Domain Correlation findings.
- `aws-sdk-imagebuilder` (1.52.0): Added support for EC2 Image Builder's integration with AWS Marketplace for Marketplace components.
- `aws-sdk-invoicing` (1.0.0): AWS Invoice Configuration allows you to receive separate AWS invoices based on your organizational needs. You can use the AWS SDKs to manage Invoice Units and programmatically fetch the information of the invoice receiver.
- `aws-sdk-memorydb` (1.51.0): Amazon MemoryDB SDK now supports all APIs for Multi-Region. Please refer to the updated Amazon MemoryDB public documentation for detailed information on API usage.
- `aws-sdk-networkflowmonitor` (1.0.0): This release adds documentation for a new feature in Amazon CloudWatch called Network Flow Monitor. You can use Network Flow Monitor to get near real-time metrics, including retransmissions and data transferred, for your actual workloads.
- `aws-sdk-opensearch` (1.62.0): This feature introduces support for CRUDL APIs, enabling the creation and management of Connected data sources.
- `aws-sdk-organizations` (1.56.0): Add support for policy operations on the DECLARATIVE_POLICY_EC2 policy type.
- `aws-sdk-qbusiness` (1.55.0): Amazon Q Business now supports capabilities to extract insights and answer questions from visual elements embedded within documents, a browser extension for Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, and Microsoft Edge, and attachments across conversations.
- `aws-sdk-qconnect` (1.55.0): This release adds following capabilities: Configuring safeguards via AIGuardrails for Q in Connect inferencing, and APIs to support Q&A self-service use cases
- `aws-sdk-rds` (1.68.0): Amazon RDS supports CloudWatch Database Insights. You can use the SDK to create, modify, and describe the DatabaseInsightsMode for your DB instances and clusters.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.64.0): Amazon S3 introduces support for AWS Dedicated Local Zones
- `aws-sdk-s3control` (1.53.0): Amazon S3 introduces support for AWS Dedicated Local Zones
- `aws-sdk-securityhub` (1.53.0): Add new Multi Domain Correlation findings.
- `aws-sdk-securityir` (1.0.0): AWS Security Incident Response is a purpose-built security incident solution designed to help customers prepare for, respond to, and recover from security incidents.
- `aws-sdk-transfer` (1.55.0): AWS Transfer Family now offers Web apps that enables simple and secure access to data stored in Amazon S3.
- `aws-sdk-vpclattice` (1.51.0): Lattice APIs that allow sharing and access of VPC resources across accounts.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-ecs` (1.56.1): This release adds support for Container Insights with Enhanced Observability for Amazon ECS.

November 27th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.64.0): Add support for specifying embeddingDataType, either FLOAT32 or BINARY
- `aws-sdk-config` (1.52.0): AWS Config adds support for service-linked recorders, a new type of Config recorder managed by AWS services to record specific subsets of resource configuration data and functioning independently from customer managed AWS Config recorders.
- `aws-sdk-fsx` (1.54.0): This release adds EFA support to increase FSx for Lustre file systems' throughput performance to a single client instance. This can be done by specifying EfaEnabled=true at the time of creation of Persistent_2 file systems.
- `aws-sdk-observabilityadmin` (1.0.0): Amazon CloudWatch Observability Admin adds the ability to audit telemetry configuration for AWS resources in customers AWS Accounts and Organizations. The release introduces new APIs to turn on/off the new experience, which supports discovering supported AWS resources and their state of telemetry.

November 26th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagent` (1.63.0): Custom Orchestration API release for AWSBedrockAgents.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.62.0): Custom Orchestration and Streaming configurations API release for AWSBedrockAgents.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.76.0): Enables access to ValueMap and ValueInteger types for SegmentAttributes and fixes deserialization bug for DescribeContactFlow in AmazonConnect Public API
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.93.0): Adds support for Time-based Copy for EBS Snapshots and Cross Region PrivateLink. Time-based Copy ensures that EBS Snapshots are copied within and across AWS Regions in a specified timeframe. Cross Region PrivateLink enables customers to connect to VPC endpoint services hosted in other AWS Regions.
- `aws-sdk-qapps` (1.17.0): Private sharing, file upload and data collection feature support for Q Apps

November 25th, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-directconnect` (1.51.0): Update DescribeDirectConnectGatewayAssociations API to return associated core network information if a Direct Connect gateway is attached to a Cloud WAN core network.
- `aws-sdk-networkmanager` (1.52.0): This release adds native Direct Connect integration on Cloud WAN enabling customers to directly attach their Direct Connect gateways to Cloud WAN without the need for an intermediate Transit Gateway.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.63.0): Amazon Simple Storage Service / Features: Add support for ETag based conditional writes in PutObject and CompleteMultiPartUpload APIs to prevent unintended object modifications.

November 22nd, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-autoscaling` (1.57.0): Now, Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling customers can enable target tracking policies to take quicker scaling decisions, enhancing their application performance and EC2 utilization. To get started, specify target tracking to monitor a metric that is available on Amazon CloudWatch at seconds-level interval.
- `aws-sdk-bcmpricingcalculator` (1.0.0): Initial release of the AWS Billing and Cost Management Pricing Calculator API.
- `aws-sdk-bedrockagentruntime` (1.61.0): InvokeInlineAgent API release to help invoke runtime agents without any dependency on preconfigured agents.
- `aws-sdk-chatbot` (1.39.0): Adds support for programmatic management of custom actions and aliases which can be associated with channel configurations.
- `aws-sdk-codepipeline` (1.57.0): AWS CodePipeline V2 type pipelines now support ECRBuildAndPublish and InspectorScan actions.
- `aws-sdk-cognitoidentityprovider` (1.58.0): Add support for users to sign up and sign in without passwords, using email and SMS OTPs and Passkeys. Add support for Passkeys based on WebAuthn. Add support for enhanced branding customization for hosted authentication pages with Amazon Cognito Managed Login. Add feature tiers with new pricing.
- `aws-sdk-connect` (1.75.0): Amazon Connect Service Feature: Add APIs for Amazon Connect Email Channel
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.54.0): This release adds the Impact field(contains Contribution field) to the GetAnomalies API response under RootCause
- `aws-sdk-elasticloadbalancingv2` (1.57.0): This release adds support for advertising trusted CA certificate names in associated trust stores.
- `aws-sdk-emr` (1.55.0): Advanced Scaling in Amazon EMR Managed Scaling
- `aws-sdk-inspector2` (1.56.0): Extend inspector2 service model to include ServiceQuotaExceededException.
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.59.0): Add ProvisionedPollerConfig to Lambda event-source-mapping API.
- `aws-sdk-mailmanager` (1.27.0): Added new "DeliverToQBusiness" rule action to MailManager RulesSet for ingesting email data into Amazon Q Business customer applications
- `aws-sdk-neptunegraph` (1.48.0): Add 4 new APIs to support new Export features, allowing Parquet and CSV formats. Add new arguments in Import APIs to support Parquet import. Add a new query "neptune.read" to run algorithms without loading data into database
- `aws-sdk-omics` (1.54.0): This release adds support for resource policy based cross account S3 access to sequence store read sets.
- `aws-sdk-quicksight` (1.65.0): This release includes: Update APIs to support Image, Layer Map, font customization, and Plugin Visual. Add Identity center related information in ListNamsespace API. Update API for restrictedFolder support in topics and add API for SearchTopics, Describe/Update DashboardsQA Configration.
- `aws-sdk-sagemaker` (1.87.0): This release adds APIs for new features for SageMaker endpoint to scale down to zero instances, native support for multi-adapter inference, and endpoint scaling improvements.
- `aws-sdk-ses` (1.52.0): This release adds support for starting email contacts in your Amazon Connect instance as an email receiving action.
- `aws-sdk-sfn` (1.53.0): Add support for variables and JSONata in TestState, GetExecutionHistory, DescribeStateMachine, and DescribeStateMachineForExecution

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-sns` (1.50.1): ArchivePolicy attribute added to Archive and Replay feature
- `aws-sdk-workspaces` (1.59.1): While integrating WSP-DCV rebrand, a few mentions were erroneously renamed from WSP to DCV. This release reverts those mentions back to WSP.

November 21st, 2024
===================
**Service Features:**
- `aws-sdk-apigateway` (1.51.0): Added support for custom domain names for private APIs.
- `aws-sdk-applicationautoscaling` (1.54.0): Application Auto Scaling now supports Predictive Scaling to proactively increase the desired capacity ahead of predicted demand, ensuring improved availability and responsiveness for customers' applications. This feature is currently only made available for Amazon ECS Service scalable targets.
- `aws-sdk-appsync` (1.57.0): Add support for the Amazon Bedrock Runtime.
- `aws-sdk-cloudfront` (1.54.0): Adds support for Origin Selection between EMPv2 origins based on media quality score.
- `aws-sdk-cloudtrail` (1.54.0): This release introduces new APIs for creating and managing CloudTrail Lake dashboards. It also adds support for resource-based policies on CloudTrail EventDataStore and Dashboard resource.
- `aws-sdk-cloudwatchlogs` (1.58.0): Adds "Create field indexes to improve query performance and reduce scan volume" and "Transform logs during ingestion". Updates documentation for "PutLogEvents with Entity".
- `aws-sdk-costexplorer` (1.53.0): This release introduces three new APIs that enable you to estimate the cost, coverage, and utilization impact of Savings Plans you plan to purchase. The three APIs are StartCommitmentPurchaseAnalysis, GetCommitmentPurchaseAnalysis, and ListCommitmentPurchaseAnalyses.
- `aws-sdk-ec2` (1.92.0): Adds support for requesting future-dated Capacity Reservations with a minimum commitment duration, enabling IPAM for organizational units within AWS Organizations, reserving EC2 Capacity Blocks that start in 30 minutes, and extending the end date of existing Capacity Blocks.
- `aws-sdk-elasticache` (1.54.0): Added support to modify the engine type for existing ElastiCache Users and User Groups. Customers can now modify the engine type from redis to valkey.
- `aws-sdk-health` (1.50.0): Adds metadata property to an AffectedEntity.
- `aws-sdk-iot` (1.56.0): General Availability (GA) release of AWS IoT Device Management - Commands, to trigger light-weight remote actions on targeted devices
- `aws-sdk-iotfleetwise` (1.53.0): AWS IoT FleetWise now includes campaign parameters to store and forward data, configure MQTT topic as a data destination, and collect diagnostic trouble code data. It includes APIs for network agnostic data collection using custom decoding interfaces, and monitoring the last known state of vehicles.
- `aws-sdk-iotjobsdataplane` (1.50.0): General Availability (GA) release of AWS IoT Device Management - Commands, to trigger light-weight remote actions on targeted devices
- `aws-sdk-lambda` (1.58.0): Adds support for metrics for event source mappings for AWS Lambda
- `aws-sdk-notifications` (1.0.0): This release adds support for AWS User Notifications. You can now configure and view notifications from AWS services in a central location using the AWS SDK.
- `aws-sdk-notificationscontacts` (1.0.0): This release adds support for AWS User Notifications Contacts. You can now configure and view email contacts for AWS User Notifications using the AWS SDK.
- `aws-sdk-resiliencehub` (1.52.0): AWS Resilience Hub's new summary view visually represents applications' resilience through charts, enabling efficient resilience management. It provides a consolidated view of the app portfolio's resilience state and allows data export for custom stakeholder reporting.
- `aws-sdk-s3` (1.62.0): Add support for conditional deletes for the S3 DeleteObject and DeleteObjects APIs. Add support for write offset bytes option used to append to objects with the S3 PutObject API.
- `aws-sdk-ssm` (1.55.0): Added support for providing high-level overviews of managed nodes and previewing the potential impact of a runbook execution.
- `aws-sdk-ssmquicksetup` (1.14.0): Add methods that retrieve details about deployed configurations: ListConfigurations, GetConfiguration
- `aws-sdk-xray` (1.50.0): AWS X-Ray introduces Transaction Search APIs, enabling span ingestion into CloudWatch Logs for high-scale trace data indexing. These APIs support span-level queries, trace graph generation, and metric correlation for deeper application insights.

**Service Documentation:**
- `aws-sdk-elasticloadbalancingv2` (1.56.1): This feature adds support for enabling zonal shift on cross-zone enabled Application Load Balancer, as well as modifying HTTP request and response headers.
